text_en: The Revelation of Jesus Christ , which God gave unto him, to make known to his servants the things which must shortly come to pass: and signified, sending by his angel to his servant John ,
text_la: Apocalypsis Jesu Christi, quam dedit illi Deus palam facere servis suis, quæ oportet fieri cito : et significavit, mittens per angelum suum servo suo Joanni,
text_pt: Revelação de Jesus Cristo, a qual Deus lhe deu, para mostrar aos seus servos as coisas que brevemente devem acontecer; e pelo seu anjo as enviou, e as notificou a João seu servo;
text_el: Ἀποκάλυψις Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἣν ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεός, δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει, καὶ ἐσήμανεν ἀποστείλας διὰ τοῦ ἀγγέλου αὐτοῦ τῷ δούλῳ αὐτοῦ Ἰωάννῃ,

text_en: who has given testimony to the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ , what things soever he has seen.
text_la: qui testimonium perhibuit verbo Dei, et testimonium Jesu Christi, quæcumque vidit.
text_pt: O qual testificou da palavra de Deus, e do testemunho de Jesus Cristo, e de tudo o que tem visto.
text_el: ὃς ἐμαρτύρησεν τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅσα εἶδεν.

text_en: Blessed is he that reads and hears the words of this prophecy : and keeps those things which are written in it. For the time is at hand.
text_la: Beatus qui legit, et audit verba prophetiæ hujus, et servat ea, quæ in ea scripta sunt : tempus enim prope est.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado aquele que lê, e os que ouvem as palavras desta profecia, e guardam as coisas que nela estão escritas; porque o tempo está próximo.
text_el: μακάριος ὁ ἀναγινώσκων καὶ οἱ ἀκούοντες τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας καὶ τηροῦντες τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ γεγραμμένα, ὁ γὰρ καιρὸς ἐγγύς.

text_en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia . Grace be unto you and peace, from him that is and that was and that is to come: and from the seven spirits which are before his throne:
text_la: Joannes septem ecclesiis, quæ sunt in Asia. Gratia vobis, et pax ab eo, qui est, et qui erat, et qui venturus est : et a septem spiritibus qui in conspectu throni ejus sunt:
text_pt: João, às sete igrejas que estão na Ásia: Graça e paz seja convosco da parte daquele que é, e que era, e que há de vir, e da dos sete espíritos que estão diante do seu trono;
text_el: Ἰωάννης ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις ταῖς ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἑπτὰ πνευμάτων ἃ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And from Jesus Christ , who is the faithful witness, the first begotten of the dead and the prince of the kings of the earth, who has loved us and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
text_la: et a Jesu Christo, qui est testis fidelis, primogenitus mortuorum, et princeps regum terræ, qui dilexit nos, et lavit nos a peccatis nostris in sanguine suo,
text_pt: E da parte de Jesus Cristo, que é a fiel testemunha, o primogênito dentre os mortos e o príncipe dos reis da terra. Àquele que nos amou, e em seu sangue nos lavou dos nossos pecados,
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστός, ὁ πρωτότοκος τῶν νεκρῶν καὶ ὁ ἄρχων τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς. τῷ ἀγαπῶντι ἡμᾶς καὶ λύσαντι ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν [ἡμῶν] ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ,

text_en: and has made us a kingdom, and priests to God and his Father . To him be glory and empire for ever and ever. Amen .
text_la: et fecit nos regnum, et sacerdotes Deo et Patri suo : ipsi gloria et imperium in sæcula sæculorum. Amen.
text_pt: E nos fez reis e sacerdotes para Deus e seu Pai; a ele glória e poder para todo o sempre. Amém.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἡμᾶς βασιλείαν, ἱερεῖς τῷ θεῷ καὶ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ, αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας: ἀμήν.

text_en: Behold, he comes with the clouds, and every eye shall see him: and they also that pierced him. And all the tribes of the earth shall bewail themselves because of him. Even so. Amen .
text_la: Ecce venit cum nubibus, et videbit eum omnis oculus, et qui eum pupugerunt. Et plangent se super eum omnes tribus terræ. Etiam : amen.
text_pt: Eis que vem com as nuvens, e todo o olho o verá, até os mesmos que o traspassaram; e todas as tribos da terra se lamentarão sobre ele. Sim. Amém.
text_el: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται μετὰ τῶν νεφελῶν, καὶ ὄψεται αὐτὸν πᾶς ὀφθαλμὸς καὶ οἵτινες αὐτὸν ἐξεκέντησαν, καὶ κόψονται ἐπ' αὐτὸν πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς. ναί, ἀμήν.

text_en: I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end, says the Lord God , who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.
text_la: Ego sum alpha et omega, principium et finis, dicit Dominus Deus : qui est, et qui erat, et qui venturus est, omnipotens.
text_pt: Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o princípio e o fim, diz o Senhor, que é, e que era, e que há de vir, o Todo-Poderoso.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, λέγει κύριος ὁ θεός, ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος, ὁ παντοκράτωρ.

text_en: I, John , your brother and your partner in tribulation and in the kingdom and patience in Christ Jesus , was in the island which is called Patmos , for the word of God and for the testimony of Jesus .
text_la: Ego Joannes frater vester, et particeps in tribulatione, et regno, et patientia in Christo Jesu : fui in insula, quæ appellatur Patmos, propter verbum Dei, et testimonium Jesu:
text_pt: Eu, João, que também sou vosso irmão, e companheiro na aflição, e no reino, e paciência de Jesus Cristo, estava na ilha chamada Patmos, por causa da palavra de Deus, e pelo testemunho de Jesus Cristo.
text_el: Ἐγὼ Ἰωάννης, ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν καὶ συγκοινωνὸς ἐν τῇ θλίψει καὶ βασιλείᾳ καὶ ὑπομονῇ ἐν Ἰησοῦ, ἐγενόμην ἐν τῇ νήσῳ τῇ καλουμένῃ Πάτμῳ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ.

text_en: I was in the spirit on the Lord's day and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
text_la: fui in spiritu in dominica die, et audivi post me vocem magnam tamquam tubæ,
text_pt: Eu fui arrebatado no Espírito no dia do Senhor, e ouvi detrás de mim uma grande voz, como de trombeta,
text_el: ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι ἐν τῇ κυριακῇ ἡμέρᾳ, καὶ ἤκουσα ὀπίσω μου φωνὴν μεγάλην ὡς σάλπιγγος

text_en: saying: What you see, write in a book and send to the seven churches which are in Asia : to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamus and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea .
text_la: dicentis : Quod vides, scribe in libro : et mitte septem ecclesiis, quæ sunt in Asia, Epheso, et Smyrnæ, et Pergamo, et Thyatiræ, et Sardis, et Philadelphiæ, et Laodiciæ.
text_pt: Que dizia: Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o primeiro e o derradeiro; e o que vês, escreve-o num livro, e envia-o às sete igrejas que estão na Ásia: a Éfeso, e a Esmirna, e a Pérgamo, e a Tiatira, e a Sardes, e a Filadélfia, e a Laodicéia.
text_el: λεγούσης, ὃ βλέπεις γράψον εἰς βιβλίον καὶ πέμψον ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαις, εἰς Ἔφεσον καὶ εἰς Σμύρναν καὶ εἰς Πέργαμον καὶ εἰς Θυάτειρα καὶ εἰς Σάρδεις καὶ εἰς Φιλαδέλφειαν καὶ εἰς Λαοδίκειαν.

text_en: And I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks:
text_la: Et conversus sum ut viderem vocem, quæ loquebatur mecum : et conversus vidi septem candelabra aurea:
text_pt: E virei-me para ver quem falava comigo. E, virando-me, vi sete castiçais de ouro;
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψα βλέπειν τὴν φωνὴν ἥτις ἐλάλει μετ' ἐμοῦ: καὶ ἐπιστρέψας εἶδον ἑπτὰ λυχνίας χρυσᾶς,

text_en: And in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks, one like to the Son of man , clothed with a garment down to the feet, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
text_la: et in medio septem candelabrorum aureorum, similem Filio hominis vestitum podere, et præcinctum ad mamillas zona aurea:
text_pt: E no meio dos sete castiçais um semelhante ao Filho do homem, vestido até aos pés de uma roupa comprida, e cingido pelos peitos com um cinto de ouro.
text_el: καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν λυχνιῶν ὅμοιον υἱὸν ἀνθρώπου, ἐνδεδυμένον ποδήρη καὶ περιεζωσμένον πρὸς τοῖς μαστοῖς ζώνην χρυσᾶν:

text_en: And his head and his hairs were white as white wool and as snow. And his eyes were as a flame of fire:
text_la: caput autem ejus, et capilli erant candidi tamquam lana alba, et tamquam nix, et oculi ejus tamquam flamma ignis:
text_pt: E a sua cabeça e cabelos eram brancos como lã branca, como a neve, e os seus olhos como chama de fogo;
text_el: ἡ δὲ κεφαλὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ τρίχες λευκαὶ ὡς ἔριον λευκόν, ὡς χιών, καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ὡς φλὸξ πυρός,

text_en: And his feet like unto fine brass, as in a burning furnace. And his voice as the sound of many waters.
text_la: et pedes ejus similes auricalco, sicut in camino ardenti, et vox illius tamquam vox aquarum multarum:
text_pt: E os seus pés, semelhantes a latão reluzente, como se tivessem sido refinados numa fornalha, e a sua voz como a voz de muitas águas.
text_el: καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ ὡς ἐν καμίνῳ πεπυρωμένης, καὶ ἡ φωνὴ αὐτοῦ ὡς φωνὴ ὑδάτων πολλῶν,

text_en: And he had in his right hand seven stars. And from his mouth came out a sharp two-edged sword. And his face was as the sun shines in his power.
text_la: et habebat in dextera sua stellas septem : et de ore ejus gladius utraque parte acutus exibat : et facies ejus sicut sol lucet in virtute sua.
text_pt: E ele tinha na sua destra sete estrelas; e da sua boca saía uma aguda espada de dois fios; e o seu rosto era como o sol, quando na sua força resplandece.
text_el: καὶ ἔχων ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ ἀστέρας ἑπτά, καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ῥομφαία δίστομος ὀξεῖα ἐκπορευομένη, καὶ ἡ ὄψις αὐτοῦ ὡς ὁ ἥλιος φαίνει ἐν τῇ δυνάμει αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And when I had seen him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying: Fear not. I am the First and the Last,
text_la: Et cum vidissem eum, cecidi ad pedes ejus tamquam mortuus. Et posuit dexteram suam super me, dicens : Noli timere : ego sum primus, et novissimus,
text_pt: E eu, quando o vi, caí a seus pés como morto; e ele pôs sobre mim a sua destra, dizendo-me: Não temas; Eu sou o primeiro e o último;
text_el: καὶ ὅτε εἶδον αὐτόν, ἔπεσα πρὸς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ὡς νεκρός: καὶ ἔθηκεν τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπ' ἐμὲ λέγων, μὴ φοβοῦ: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος,

text_en: and alive, and was dead. And behold I am living for ever and ever and have the keys of death and of hell.
text_la: et vivus, et fui mortuus, et ecce sum vivens in sæcula sæculorum : et habeo claves mortis, et inferni.
text_pt: E o que vivo e fui morto, mas eis aqui estou vivo para todo o sempre. Amém. E tenho as chaves da morte e do inferno.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ζῶν, καὶ ἐγενόμην νεκρὸς καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶν εἰμι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, καὶ ἔχω τὰς κλεῖς τοῦ θανάτου καὶ τοῦ ᾅδου.

text_en: Write therefore the things which you have seen: and which are: and which must be done hereafter.
text_la: Scribe ergo quæ vidisti, et quæ sunt, et quæ oportet fieri post hæc.
text_pt: Escreve as coisas que tens visto, e as que são, e as que depois destas hão de acontecer;
text_el: γράψον οὖν ἃ εἶδες καὶ ἃ εἰσὶν καὶ ἃ μέλλει γίνεσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα.

text_en: The mystery of the seven stars, which you saw in my right hand and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches . And the seven candlesticks are the seven churches .
text_la: Sacramentum septem stellarum, quas vidisti in dextera mea, et septem candelabra aurea : septem stellæ, angeli sunt septem ecclesiarum : et candelabra septem, septem ecclesiæ sunt.
text_pt: O mistério das sete estrelas, que viste na minha destra, e dos sete castiçais de ouro. As sete estrelas são os anjos das sete igrejas, e os sete castiçais, que viste, são as sete igrejas.
text_el: τὸ μυστήριον τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀστέρων οὓς εἶδες ἐπὶ τῆς δεξιᾶς μου, καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ λυχνίας τὰς χρυσᾶς: οἱ ἑπτὰ ἀστέρες ἄγγελοι τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησιῶν εἰσιν, καὶ αἱ λυχνίαι αἱ ἑπτὰ ἑπτὰ ἐκκλησίαι εἰσίν.

text_en: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write: These things says he who holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks:
text_la: Angelo Ephesi ecclesiæ scribe : Hæc dicit, qui tenet septem stellas in dextera sua, qui ambulat in medio septem candelabrorum aureorum:
text_pt: Escreve ao anjo da igreja de Éfeso: Isto diz aquele que tem na sua destra as sete estrelas, que anda no meio dos sete castiçais de ouro:
text_el: Τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῷ ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον: τάδε λέγει ὁ κρατῶν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ, ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἑπτὰ λυχνιῶν τῶν χρυσῶν:

text_en: I know your works and your labour and your patience and how you can not bear them that are evil . And you have tried them who say they are apostles and are not: and have found them liars :
text_la: Scio opera tua, et laborem, et patientiam tuam, et quia non potes sustinere malos : et tentasti eos, qui se dicunt apostolos esse, et non sunt : et invenisti eos mendaces:
text_pt: Conheço as tuas obras, e o teu trabalho, e a tua paciência, e que não podes sofrer os maus; e puseste à prova os que dizem ser apóstolos, e o não são, e tu os achaste mentirosos.
text_el: οἶδα τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ τὸν κόπον καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου, καὶ ὅτι οὐ δύνῃ βαστάσαι κακούς, καὶ ἐπείρασας τοὺς λέγοντας ἑαυτοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν, καὶ εὗρες αὐτοὺς ψευδεῖς:

text_en: And you have patience and have endured for my name and have not fainted.
text_la: et patientiam habes, et sustinuisti propter nomen meum, et non defecisti.
text_pt: E sofreste, e tens paciência; e trabalhaste pelo meu nome, e não te cansaste.
text_el: καὶ ὑπομονὴν ἔχεις, καὶ ἐβάστασας διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου, καὶ οὐ κεκοπίακες.

text_en: But I have somewhat against you, because you have left your first charity .
text_la: Sed habeo adversum te, quod caritatem tuam primam reliquisti.
text_pt: Tenho, porém, contra ti que deixaste o teu primeiro amor.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην σου τὴν πρώτην ἀφῆκες.

text_en: Be mindful therefore from whence you are fallen: and do penance and do the first works. Or else I come to you and will move your candlestick out of its place, unless you do penance .
text_la: Memor esto itaque unde excideris : et age pœnitentiam, et prima opera fac : sin autem, venio tibi, et movebo candelabrum tuum de loco suo, nisi pœnitentiam egeris.
text_pt: Lembra-te, pois, de onde caíste, e arrepende-te, e pratica as primeiras obras; quando não, brevemente a ti virei, e tirarei do seu lugar o teu castiçal, se não te arrependeres.
text_el: μνημόνευε οὖν πόθεν πέπτωκας, καὶ μετανόησον καὶ τὰ πρῶτα ἔργα ποίησον: εἰ δὲ μή, ἔρχομαί σοι καὶ κινήσω τὴν λυχνίαν σου ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῆς, ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσῃς.

text_en: But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaites , which I also hate .
text_la: Sed hoc habes, quia odisti facta Nicolaitarum, quæ et ego odi.
text_pt: Tens, porém, isto: que odeias as obras dos nicolaítas, as quais eu também odeio.
text_el: ἀλλὰ τοῦτο ἔχεις, ὅτι μισεῖς τὰ ἔργα τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν, ἃ κἀγὼ μισῶ.

text_en: He that has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches : To him that overcomes I will give to eat of the tree of life which is in the paradise of my God.
text_la: Qui habet aurem, audiat quid Spiritus dicat ecclesiis : Vincenti dabo edere de ligno vitæ, quod est in paradiso Dei mei.
text_pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas: Ao que vencer, dar-lhe-ei a comer da árvore da vida, que está no meio do paraíso de Deus.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ φαγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And to the angel of the church of Smyrna write: These things says the First and the Last, who was dead and is alive:
text_la: Et angelo Smyrnæ ecclesiæ scribe : Hæc dicit primus, et novissimus, qui fuit mortuus, et vivit:
text_pt: E ao anjo da igreja em Esmirna, escreve: Isto diz o primeiro e o último, que foi morto, e reviveu:
text_el: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῷ ἐν Σμύρνῃ ἐκκλησίας γράψον: τάδε λέγει ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, ὃς ἐγένετο νεκρὸς καὶ ἔζησεν:

text_en: I know your tribulation and your poverty: but you are rich. And you are blasphemed by them that say they are Jews and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan .
text_la: Scio tribulationem tuam, et paupertatem tuam, sed dives es : et blasphemaris ab his, qui se dicunt Judæos esse, et non sunt, sed sunt synagoga Satanæ.
text_pt: Conheço as tuas obras, e tribulação, e pobreza (mas tu és rico), e a blasfêmia dos que se dizem judeus, e não o são, mas são a sinagoga de Satanás.
text_el: Οἶδά σου τὴν θλῖψιν καὶ τὴν πτωχείαν, ἀλλὰ πλούσιος εἶ, καὶ τὴν βλασφημίαν ἐκ τῶν λεγόντων Ἰουδαίους εἶναι ἑαυτούς, καὶ οὐκ εἰσὶν ἀλλὰ συναγωγὴ τοῦ Σατανᾶ.

text_en: Fear none of those things which you shall suffer. Behold, the devil will cast some of you into prison , that you may be tried: and you shall have tribulation ten days. Be faithful unto death: and I will give you the crown of life.
text_la: Nihil horum timeas quæ passurus es. Ecce missurus est diabolus aliquos ex vobis in carcerem ut tentemini : et habebitis tribulationem diebus decem. Esto fidelis usque ad mortem, et dabo tibi coronam vitæ.
text_pt: Nada temas das coisas que hás de padecer. Eis que o diabo lançará alguns de vós na prisão, para que sejais tentados; e tereis uma tribulação de dez dias. Sê fiel até à morte, e dar-te-ei a coroa da vida.
text_el: μὴ φοβοῦ ἃ μέλλεις πάσχειν. ἰδοὺ μέλλει βάλλειν ὁ διάβολος ἐξ ὑμῶν εἰς φυλακὴν ἵνα πειρασθῆτε, καὶ ἔχητε θλῖψιν ἡμερῶν δέκα. γίνου πιστὸς ἄχρι θανάτου, καὶ δώσω σοι τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς.

text_en: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches : He that shall overcome shall not be hurt by the second death.
text_la: Qui habet aurem, audiat quid Spiritus dicat ecclesiis : Qui vicerit, non lædetur a morte secunda.
text_pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas: O que vencer não receberá o dano da segunda morte.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις. ὁ νικῶν οὐ μὴ ἀδικηθῇ ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου τοῦ δευτέρου.

text_en: And to the angel of the church of Pergamus write: These things says he that has the sharp two-edged sword:
text_la: Et angelo Pergami ecclesiæ scribe : Hæc dicit qui habet rhomphæam utraque parte acutam:
text_pt: E ao anjo da igreja que está em Pérgamo escreve: Isto diz aquele que tem a espada aguda de dois fios:
text_el: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Περγάμῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον: τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὴν ῥομφαίαν τὴν δίστομον τὴν ὀξεῖαν:

text_en: I know where you dwell, where the seat of Satan is. And you hold fast my name and have not denied my faith . Even in those days when Antipas was my faithful witness, who was slain among you, where Satan dwells.
text_la: Scio ubi habitas, ubi sedes est Satanæ : et tenes nomen meum, et non negasti fidem meam. Et in diebus illis Antipas testis meus fidelis, qui occisus est apud vos ubi Satanas habitat.
text_pt: Conheço as tuas obras, e onde habitas, que é onde está o trono de Satanás; e reténs o meu nome, e não negaste a minha fé, ainda nos dias de Antipas, minha fiel testemunha, o qual foi morto entre vós, onde Satanás habita.
text_el: οἶδα ποῦ κατοικεῖς, ὅπου ὁ θρόνος τοῦ Σατανᾶ, καὶ κρατεῖς τὸ ὄνομά μου, καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὴν πίστιν μου καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἀντιπᾶς ὁ μάρτυς μου ὁ πιστός [μου], ὃς ἀπεκτάνθη παρ' ὑμῖν, ὅπου ὁ Σατανᾶς κατοικεῖ.

text_en: But I have against you a few things: because you have there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam who taught Balac to cast a stumbling block before the children of Israel , to eat and to commit fornication.
text_la: Sed habeo adversus te pauca : quia habes illic tenentes doctrinam Balaam, qui docebat Balac mittere scandalum coram filiis Israël, edere, et fornicari:
text_pt: Mas algumas poucas coisas tenho contra ti, porque tens lá os que seguem a doutrina de Balaão, o qual ensinava Balaque a lançar tropeços diante dos filhos de Israel, para que comessem dos sacrifícios da idolatria, e fornicassem.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὀλίγα, ὅτι ἔχεις ἐκεῖ κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν Βαλαάμ, ὃς ἐδίδασκεν τῷ Βαλὰκ βαλεῖν σκάνδαλον ἐνώπιον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ, φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα καὶ πορνεῦσαι.

text_en: So have you also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaites .
text_la: ita habes et tu tenentes doctrinam Nicolaitarum.
text_pt: Assim tens também os que seguem a doutrina dos nicolaítas, o que eu odeio.
text_el: οὕτως ἔχεις καὶ σὺ κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν Νικολαϊτῶν ὁμοίως.

text_en: In like manner do penance . If not, I will come to you quickly and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
text_la: Similiter pœnitentiam age : si quominus veniam tibi cito, et pugnabo cum illis in gladio oris mei.
text_pt: Arrepende-te, pois, quando não em breve virei a ti, e contra eles batalharei com a espada da minha boca.
text_el: μετανόησον: οὖν εἰ δὲ μή, ἔρχομαί σοι ταχύ καὶ πολεμήσω μετ' αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ τοῦ στόματός μου.

text_en: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches : To him that overcomes I will give the hidden manna and will give him a white counter: and in the counter, a new name written, which no man knows but he that receives it.
text_la: Qui habet aurem, audiat quid Spiritus dicat ecclesiis : Vincenti dabo manna absconditum, et dabo illi calculum candidum : et in calculo nomen novum scriptum, quod nemo scit, nisi qui accipit.
text_pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas: Ao que vencer darei eu a comer do maná escondido, e dar-lhe-ei uma pedra branca, e na pedra um novo nome escrito, o qual ninguém conhece senão aquele que o recebe.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις: τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ τοῦ μάννα τοῦ κεκρυμμένου, καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ ψῆφον λευκὴν, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ψῆφον ὄνομα καινὸν γεγραμμένον, ὃ οὐδεὶς οἶδεν εἰ μὴ ὁ λαμβάνων.

text_en: And to the angel of the church of Thyatira write: These things says the Son of God , who has his eyes like to a flame of fire and his feet like to fine brass.
text_la: Et angelo Thyatiræ ecclesiæ scribe : Hæc dicit Filius Dei, qui habet oculos tamquam flammam ignis, et pedes ejus similes auricalco:
text_pt: E ao anjo da igreja de Tiatira escreve: Isto diz o Filho de Deus, que tem seus olhos como chama de fogo, e os pés semelhantes ao latão reluzente:
text_el: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῷ ἐν Θυατείροις ἐκκλησίας γράψον: τάδε λέγει ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ, ὁ ἔχων τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς [αὐτοῦ] ὡς φλόγα πυρός, καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ:

text_en: I know your works and your faith and your charity and your ministry and your patience and your last works, which are more than the former.
text_la: Novi opera tua, et fidem, et caritatem tuam, et ministerium, et patientiam tuam, et opera tua novissima plura prioribus.
text_pt: Eu conheço as tuas obras, e o teu amor, e o teu serviço, e a tua fé, e a tua paciência, e que as tuas últimas obras são mais do que as primeiras.
text_el: οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν καὶ τὴν διακονίαν καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν, σου καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου τὰ ἔσχατα πλείονα τῶν πρώτων.

text_en: But I have against you a few things: because you suffer the woman Jezabel , who calls herself a prophetess , to teach and to seduce my servants, to commit fornication and to eat of things sacrificed to idols .
text_la: Sed habeo adversus te pauca : quia permittis mulierem Jezabel, quæ se dicit propheten, docere, et seducere servos meos, fornicari, et manducare de idolothytis.
text_pt: Mas algumas poucas coisas tenho contra ti que deixas Jezabel, mulher que se diz profetisa, ensinar e enganar os meus servos, para que forniquem e comam dos sacrifícios da idolatria.
text_el: ἀλλὰ' ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι ἀφεῖς τὴν γυναῖκα Ἰεζάβελ, ἡ λέγουσα ἑαυτὴν προφῆτιν, καὶ διδάσκει καὶ πλανᾷ τοὺς ἐμοὺς δούλους πορνεῦσαι καὶ φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα.

text_en: And I gave her a time that she might do penance : and she will not repent of her fornication.
text_la: Et dedi illi tempus ut pœnitentiam ageret : et non vult pœnitere a fornicatione sua.
text_pt: E dei-lhe tempo para que se arrependesse da sua fornicação; e não se arrependeu.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῇ χρόνον ἵνα μετανοήσῃ, καὶ οὐ θέλει μετανοῆσαι ἐκ τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς.

text_en: Behold, I will cast her into a bed: and they that commit adultery with her shall be in very great tribulation, except they do penance from their deeds,
text_la: Ecce mittam eam in lectum : et qui mœchantur cum ea, in tribulatione maxima erunt, nisi pœnitentiam ab operibus suis egerint.
text_pt: Eis que a porei numa cama, e sobre os que adulteram com ela virá grande tribulação, se não se arrependerem das suas obras.
text_el: ἰδοὺ βάλλω αὐτὴν εἰς κλίνην, καὶ τοὺς μοιχεύοντας μετ' αὐτῆς εἰς θλῖψιν μεγάλην, ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσουσιν ἐκ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῆς:

text_en: and I will kill her children with death: and all the churches shall know that I am he that searches the reins and hearts. And I will give to every one of you according to your works. But to you I say,
text_la: Et filios ejus interficiam in morte, et scient omnes ecclesiæ, quia ego sum scrutans renes, et corda : et dabo unicuique vestrum secundum opera sua. Vobis autem dico,
text_pt: E ferirei de morte a seus filhos, e todas as igrejas saberão que eu sou aquele que sonda os rins e os corações. E darei a cada um de vós segundo as vossas obras.
text_el: καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς ἀποκτενῶ ἐν θανάτῳ: καὶ γνώσονται πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἐραυνῶν νεφροὺς καὶ καρδίας, καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ὑμῶν.

text_en: and to the rest who are at Thyatira : Whosoever have not this doctrine and who have not known the depths of Satan , as they say: I will not put upon you any other burden.
text_la: et ceteris qui Thyatiræ estis : quicumque non habent doctrinam hanc, et qui non cognoverunt altitudines Satanæ, quemadmodum dicunt, non mittam super vos aliud pondus:
text_pt: Mas eu vos digo a vós, e aos restantes que estão em Tiatira, a todos quantos não têm esta doutrina, e não conheceram, como dizem, as profundezas de Satanás, que outra carga vos não porei.
text_el: ὑμῖν δὲ λέγω τοῖς λοιποῖς τοῖς ἐν Θυατείροις, ὅσοι οὐκ ἔχουσιν τὴν διδαχὴν ταύτην, οἵτινες οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰ βαθέα τοῦ Σατανᾶ, ὡς λέγουσιν, οὐ βάλλω ἐφ' ὑμᾶς ἄλλο βάρος:

text_en: Yet that which you have, hold fast till I come.
text_la: tamen id quod habetis, tenete donec veniam.
text_pt: Mas o que tendes, retende-o até que eu venha.
text_el: πλὴν ὃ ἔχετε κρατήσατε ἄχρις οὗ ἂν ἥξω.

text_en: And he that shall overcome and keep my words unto the end, I will give him power over the nations.
text_la: Et qui vicerit, et custodierit usque in finem opera mea, dabo illi potestatem super gentes,
text_pt: E ao que vencer, e guardar até ao fim as minhas obras, eu lhe darei poder sobre as nações,
text_el: καὶ ὁ νικῶν καὶ ὁ τηρῶν ἄχρι τέλους τὰ ἔργα μου, δώσω αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν,

text_en: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and as the vessel of a potter they shall be broken:
text_la: et reget eas in virga ferrea, et tamquam vas figuli confringentur,
text_pt: E com vara de ferro as regerá; e serão quebradas como vasos de oleiro; como também recebi de meu Pai.
text_el: καὶ ποιμανεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ, ὡς τὰ σκεύη τὰ κεραμικὰ συντρίβεται,

text_en: As I also have received of my Father . And I will give him the morning star .
text_la: sicut et ego accepi a Patre meo : et dabo illi stellam matutinam.
text_pt: E dar-lhe-ei a estrela da manhã.
text_el: ὡς κἀγὼ εἴληφα παρὰ τοῦ πατρός μου, καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ τὸν ἀστέρα τὸν πρωϊνόν.

text_en: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches .
text_la: Qui habet aurem, audiat quid Spiritus dicat ecclesiis.
text_pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.

text_en: And to the angel of the church of Sardis write: These things says he that has the seven spirits of God and the seven stars: I know your works, and that you have the name of being alive. And you are dead.
text_la: Et angelo ecclesiæ Sardis scribe : Hæc dicit qui habet septem spiritus Dei, et septem stellas : Scio opera tua, quia nomen habes quod vivas, et mortuus es.
text_pt: E ao anjo da igreja que está em Sardes escreve: Isto diz o que tem os sete espíritos de Deus, e as sete estrelas: Conheço as tuas obras, que tens nome de que vives, e estás morto.
text_el: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Σάρδεσιν ἐκκλησίας γράψον: τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὰ ἑπτὰ πνεύματα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας: οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα, ὅτι ὄνομα ἔχεις ὅτι ζῇς, καὶ νεκρὸς εἶ.

text_en: Be watchful and strengthen the things that remain, which are ready to die. For I find not your works full before my God .
text_la: Esto vigilans, et confirma cetera, quæ moritura erant. Non enim invenio opera tua plena coram Deo meo.
text_pt: Sê vigilante, e confirma os restantes, que estavam para morrer; porque não achei as tuas obras perfeitas diante de Deus.
text_el: γίνου γρηγορῶν, καὶ στήρισον τὰ λοιπὰ ἃ ἔμελλον ἀποθανεῖν, οὐ γὰρ εὕρηκά σου ἔργα πεπληρωμένα ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ μου:

text_en: Have in mind therefore in what manner you have received and heard: and observe and do penance : If then you shall not watch, I will come to you as a thief : and you shall not know at what hour I will come to you.
text_la: In mente ergo habe qualiter acceperis, et audieris, et serva, et pœnitentiam age. Si ergo non vigilaveris, veniam ad te tamquam fur et nescies qua hora veniam ad te.
text_pt: Lembra-te, pois, do que tens recebido e ouvido, e guarda-o, e arrepende-te. E, se não vigiares, virei sobre ti como um ladrão, e não saberás a que hora sobre ti virei.
text_el: μνημόνευε οὖν πῶς εἴληφας καὶ ἤκουσας, καὶ τήρει καὶ μετανόησον. ἐὰν οὖν μὴ γρηγορήσῃς, ἥξω ὡς κλέπτης, καὶ οὐ μὴ γνῷς ποίαν ὥραν ἥξω ἐπὶ σέ.

text_en: But you have a few names in Sardis which have not defiled their garments: and they shall walk with me in white, because they are worthy.
text_la: Sed habes pauca nomina in Sardis qui non inquinaverunt vestimenta sua : et ambulabunt mecum in albis, quia digni sunt.
text_pt: Mas também tens em Sardes algumas poucas pessoas que não contaminaram suas vestes, e comigo andarão de branco; porquanto são dignas disso.
text_el: ἀλλὰ ἔχεις ὀλίγα ὀνόματα ἐν Σάρδεσιν ἃ οὐκ ἐμόλυναν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν, καὶ περιπατήσουσιν μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐν λευκοῖς, ὅτι ἄξιοί εἰσιν.

text_en: He that shall overcome shall thus be clothed in white garments: and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life. And I will confess his name before my Father and before his angels .
text_la: Qui vicerit, sic vestietur vestimentis albis, et non delebo nomen ejus de libro vitæ, et confitebor nomen ejus coram Patre meo, et coram angelis ejus.
text_pt: O que vencer será vestido de vestes brancas, e de maneira nenhuma riscarei o seu nome do livro da vida; e confessarei o seu nome diante de meu Pai e diante dos seus anjos.
text_el: ὁ νικῶν οὕτως περιβαλεῖται ἐν ἱματίοις λευκοῖς, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐξαλείψω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῆς βίβλου τῆς ζωῆς, καὶ ὁμολογήσω τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐνώπιον τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀγγέλων αὐτοῦ.

text_en: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches .
text_la: Qui habet aurem, audiat quid Spiritus dicat ecclesiis.
text_pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.

text_en: And to the angel of the church of Philadelphia write: These things says the Holy One and the true one, he that has the key of David , he that opens and no man shuts, shuts and no man opens:
text_la: Et angelo Philadelphiæ ecclesiæ scribe : Hæc dicit Sanctus et Verus, qui habet clavem David : qui aperit, et nemo claudit : claudit, et nemo aperit:
text_pt: E ao anjo da igreja que está em Filadélfia escreve: Isto diz o que é santo, o que é verdadeiro, o que tem a chave de Davi; o que abre, e ninguém fecha; e fecha, e ninguém abre:
text_el: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Φιλαδελφείᾳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον: τάδε λέγει ὁ ἅγιος ὁ ἀληθινός, ὁ ἔχων τὴν κλεῖν Δαυίδ, ὁ ἀνοίγων καὶ οὐδεὶς κλείσει, καὶ κλείων καὶ οὐδεὶς ἀνοίγει:

text_en: I know your works. Behold, I have given before you a door opened, which no man can shut: because you have a little strength and have kept my word and have not denied my name .
text_la: Scio opera tua. Ecce dedi coram te ostium apertum, quod nemo potest claudere : quia modicam habes virtutem, et servasti verbum meum, et non negasti nomen meum.
text_pt: Conheço as tuas obras; eis que diante de ti pus uma porta aberta, e ninguém a pode fechar; tendo pouca força, guardaste a minha palavra, e não negaste o meu nome.
text_el: οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα: ἰδοὺ δέδωκα ἐνώπιόν σου θύραν ἠνεῳγμένην, ἣν οὐδεὶς δύναται κλεῖσαι αὐτήν: ὅτι μικρὰν ἔχεις δύναμιν, καὶ ἐτήρησάς μου τὸν λόγον καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὸ ὄνομά μου.

text_en: Behold, I will bring of the synagogue of Satan , who say they are Jews and are not, but do lie. Behold, I will make them to come and adore before your feet. And they shall know that I have loved you.
text_la: Ecce dabo de synagoga Satanæ, qui dicunt se Judæos esse, et non sunt, sed mentiuntur : ecce faciam illos ut veniant, et adorent ante pedes tuos : et scient quia ego dilexi te,
text_pt: Eis que eu farei aos da sinagoga de Satanás, aos que se dizem judeus, e não são, mas mentem: eis que eu farei que venham, e adorem prostrados a teus pés, e saibam que eu te amo.
text_el: ἰδοὺ διδῶ ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς τοῦ Σατανᾶ, τῶν λεγόντων ἑαυτοὺς Ἰουδαίους εἶναι, καὶ οὐκ εἰσὶν ἀλλὰ ψεύδονται: ἰδοὺ ποιήσω αὐτοὺς ἵνα ἥξουσιν καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν ἐνώπιον τῶν ποδῶν σου, καὶ γνῶσιν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἠγάπησά σε.

text_en: Because you have kept the word of my patience, I will also keep you from the hour of temptation , which shall come upon the whole world to try them that dwell upon the earth.
text_la: quoniam servasti verbum patientiæ meæ, et ego servabo te ab hora tentationis, quæ ventura est in orbem universum tentare habitantes in terra.
text_pt: Como guardaste a palavra da minha paciência, também eu te guardarei da hora da tentação que há de vir sobre todo o mundo, para tentar os que habitam na terra.
text_el: ὅτι ἐτήρησας τὸν λόγον τῆς ὑπομονῆς μου, κἀγώ σε τηρήσω ἐκ τῆς ὥρας τοῦ πειρασμοῦ τῆς μελλούσης ἔρχεσθαι ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκουμένης ὅλης πειράσαι τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

text_en: Behold, I come quickly: hold fast that which you have, that no man take your crown.
text_la: Ecce venio cito : tene quod habes, ut nemo accipiat coronam tuam.
text_pt: Eis que venho sem demora; guarda o que tens, para que ninguém tome a tua coroa.
text_el: ἔρχομαι ταχύ: κράτει ὃ ἔχεις, ἵνα μηδεὶς λάβῃ τὸν στέφανόν σου.

text_en: He that shall overcome, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God : and he shall go out no more. And I will write upon him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God , the new Jerusalem , which comes down out of heaven from my God , and my new name .
text_la: Qui vicerit, faciam illum columnam in templo Dei mei, et foras non egredietur amplius : et scribam super eum nomen Dei mei, et nomen civitatis Dei mei novæ Jerusalem, quæ descendit de cælo a Deo meo, et nomen meum novum.
text_pt: A quem vencer, eu o farei coluna no templo do meu Deus, e dele nunca sairá; e escreverei sobre ele o nome do meu Deus, e o nome da cidade do meu Deus, a nova Jerusalém, que desce do céu, do meu Deus, e também o meu novo nome.
text_el: ὁ νικῶν ποιήσω αὐτὸν στῦλον ἐν τῷ ναῷ τοῦ θεοῦ μου, καὶ ἔξω οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃ ἔτι, καὶ γράψω ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ μου καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως τοῦ θεοῦ μου, τῆς καινῆς Ἰερουσαλήμ, ἡ καταβαίνουσα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ μου, καὶ τὸ ὄνομά μου τὸ καινόν.

text_en: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches .
text_la: Qui habet aurem, audiat quid Spiritus dicat ecclesiis.
text_pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.

text_en: And to the angel of the church of Laodicea write: These things says the Amen , the faithful and true witness, who is the beginning of the creation of God :
text_la: Et angelo Laodiciæ ecclesiæ scribe : Hæc dicit : Amen, testis fidelis et verus, qui est principium creaturæ Dei.
text_pt: E ao anjo da igreja de Laodicéia escreve: Isto diz o Amém, a testemunha fiel e verdadeira, o princípio da criação de Deus:
text_el: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Λαοδικείᾳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον: τάδε λέγει ὁ ἀμήν, ὁ μάρτυς ὁ πιστὸς καὶ [ὁ] ἀληθινός, ἡ ἀρχὴ τῆς κτίσεως τοῦ θεοῦ:

text_en: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I would thou wert cold or hot.
text_la: Scio opera tua : quia neque frigidus es, neque calidus : utinam frigidus esses, aut calidus:
text_pt: Conheço as tuas obras, que nem és frio nem quente; quem dera foras frio ou quente!
text_el: οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα, ὅτι οὔτε ψυχρὸς εἶ οὔτε ζεστός. ὄφελον ψυχρὸς ἦς ἢ ζεστός.

text_en: But because you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will begin to vomit you out of my mouth.
text_la: sed quia tepidus es, et nec frigidus, nec calidus, incipiam te evomere ex ore meo:
text_pt: Assim, porque és morno, e não és frio nem quente, vomitar-te-ei da minha boca.
text_el: οὕτως, ὅτι χλιαρὸς εἶ καὶ οὔτε ζεστὸς οὔτε ψυχρός, μέλλω σε ἐμέσαι ἐκ τοῦ στόματός μου.

text_en: Because you say: I am rich and made wealthy and have need of nothing: and know not that you are wretched and miserable and poor and blind and naked.
text_la: quia dicis : Quod dives sum, et locupletatus, et nullius egeo : et nescis quia tu es miser, et miserabilis, et pauper, et cæcus, et nudus.
text_pt: Como dizes: Rico sou, e estou enriquecido, e de nada tenho falta; e não sabes que és um desgraçado, e miserável, e pobre, e cego, e nu;
text_el: ὅτι λέγεις ὅτι πλούσιός εἰμι καὶ πεπλούτηκα καὶ οὐδὲν χρείαν ἔχω, καὶ οὐκ οἶδας ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ταλαίπωρος καὶ ἐλεεινὸς καὶ πτωχὸς καὶ τυφλὸς καὶ γυμνός,

text_en: I counsel you to buy of me gold, fire tried, that you may be made rich and may be clothed in white garments: and that the shame of your nakedness may not appear. And anoint your eyes with eyesalve, that you may see.
text_la: Suadeo tibi emere a me aurum ignitum probatum, ut locuples fias, et vestimentis albis induaris, et non appareat confusio nuditatis tuæ, et collyrio inunge oculos tuos ut videas.
text_pt: Aconselho-te que de mim compres ouro provado no fogo, para que te enriqueças; e roupas brancas, para que te vistas, e não apareça a vergonha da tua nudez; e que unjas os teus olhos com colírio, para que vejas.
text_el: συμβουλεύω σοι ἀγοράσαι παρ' ἐμοῦ χρυσίον πεπυρωμένον ἐκ πυρὸς ἵνα πλουτήσῃς, καὶ ἱμάτια λευκὰ ἵνα περιβάλῃ καὶ μὴ φανερωθῇ ἡ αἰσχύνη τῆς γυμνότητός σου, καὶ κολλούριον ἐγχρῖσαι τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου ἵνα βλέπῃς.

text_en: Such as I love , I rebuke and chastise. Be zealous therefore and do penance .
text_la: Ego quos amo, arguo, et castigo. Æmulare ergo, et pœnitentiam age.
text_pt: Eu repreendo e castigo a todos quantos amo; sê pois zeloso, e arrepende-te.
text_el: ἐγὼ ὅσους ἐὰν φιλῶ ἐλέγχω καὶ παιδεύω: ζήλευε οὖν καὶ μετανόησον.

text_en: Behold, I stand at the gate and knock. If any man shall hear my voice and open to me the door, I will come in to him and will sup with him: and he with me.
text_la: Ecce sto ad ostium, et pulso : si quis audierit vocem meam, et aperuerit mihi januam, intrabo ad illum, et cœnabo cum illo, et ipse mecum.
text_pt: Eis que estou à porta, e bato; se alguém ouvir a minha voz, e abrir a porta, entrarei em sua casa, e com ele cearei, e ele comigo.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἕστηκα ἐπὶ τὴν θύραν καὶ κρούω: ἐάν τις ἀκούσῃ τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ ἀνοίξῃ τὴν θύραν, εἰσελεύσομαι πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ δειπνήσω μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς μετ' ἐμοῦ.

text_en: To him that shall overcome, I will give to sit with me in my throne: as I also have overcome and am set down with my Father in his throne.
text_la: Qui vicerit, dabo ei sedere mecum in throno meo : sicut et ego vici, et sedi cum Patre meo in throno ejus.
text_pt: Ao que vencer lhe concederei que se assente comigo no meu trono; assim como eu venci, e me assentei com meu Pai no seu trono.
text_el: ὁ νικῶν δώσω αὐτῷ καθίσαι μετ' ἐμοῦ ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ μου, ὡς κἀγὼ ἐνίκησα καὶ ἐκάθισα μετὰ τοῦ πατρός μου ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches .
text_la: Qui habet aurem, audiat quid Spiritus dicat ecclesiis.
text_pt: Quem tem ouvidos, ouça o que o Espírito diz às igrejas.
text_el: ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις.

text_en: After these things I looked, and behold a door was opened in heaven , and the first voice which I heard, as it were, of a trumpet speaking with me, said: Come up hither, and I will show you the things which must be done hereafter.
text_la: Post hæc vidi : et ecce ostium apertum in cælo, et vox prima, quam audivi tamquam tubæ loquentis mecum, dicens : Ascende huc, et ostendam tibi quæ oportet fieri post hæc.
text_pt: Depois destas coisas, olhei, e eis que estava uma porta aberta no céu; e a primeira voz, que como de trombeta ouvira falar comigo, disse: Sobe aqui, e mostrar-te-ei as coisas que depois destas devem acontecer.
text_el: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ θύρα ἠνεῳγμένη ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, καὶ ἡ φωνὴ ἡ πρώτη ἣν ἤκουσα ὡς σάλπιγγος λαλούσης μετ' ἐμοῦ, λέγων: ἀνάβα ὧδε, καὶ δείξω σοι ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι μετὰ ταῦτα.

text_en: And immediately I was in the spirit. And behold, there was a throne set in heaven , and upon the throne one sitting.
text_la: Et statim fui in spiritu : et ecce sedes posita erat in cælo, et supra sedem sedens.
text_pt: E logo fui arrebatado em espírito, e eis que um trono estava posto no céu, e um assentado sobre o trono.
text_el: εὐθέως ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι: καὶ ἰδοὺ θρόνος ἔκειτο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον καθήμενος,

text_en: And he that sat was to the sight like the jasper and the sardine stone. And there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
text_la: Et qui sedebat similis erat aspectui lapidis jaspidis, et sardinis : et iris erat in circuitu sedis similis visioni smaragdinæ.
text_pt: E o que estava assentado era, na aparência, semelhante à pedra jaspe e sardônica; e o arco celeste estava ao redor do trono, e parecia semelhante à esmeralda.
text_el: καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ὅμοιος ὁράσει λίθῳ ἰάσπιδι καὶ σαρδίῳ, καὶ ἶρις κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου ὅμοιος ὁράσει σμαραγδίνῳ.

text_en: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats, four and twenty ancients sitting, clothed in white garments. And on their heads were crowns of gold.
text_la: Et in circuitu sedis sedilia viginti quatuor : et super thronos viginti quatuor seniores sedentes, circumamicti vestimentis albis, et in capitibus eorum coronæ aureæ.
text_pt: E ao redor do trono havia vinte e quatro tronos; e vi assentados sobre os tronos vinte e quatro anciãos vestidos de vestes brancas; e tinham sobre suas cabeças coroas de ouro.
text_el: καὶ κυκλόθεν τοῦ θρόνου θρόνοι εἴκοσι τέσσαρες, καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θρόνους εἴκοσι τέσσαρας πρεσβυτέρους καθημένους περιβεβλημένους ἱματίοις λευκοῖς, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν στεφάνους χρυσοῦς.

text_en: And from the throne proceeded lightnings and voices and thunders. And there were seven lamps burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God .
text_la: Et de throno procedebant fulgura, et voces, et tonitrua : et septem lampades ardentes ante thronum, qui sunt septem spiritus Dei.
text_pt: E do trono saíam relâmpagos, e trovões, e vozes; e diante do trono ardiam sete lâmpadas de fogo, as quais são os sete espíritos de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου ἐκπορεύονται ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί: καὶ ἑπτὰ λαμπάδες πυρὸς καιόμεναι ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, ἅ εἰσιν τὰ ἑπτὰ πνεύματα τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: And in the sight of the throne was, as it were, a sea of glass like to crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four living creatures, full of eyes before and behind.
text_la: Et in conspectu sedis tamquam mare vitreum simile crystallo : et in medio sedis, et in circuitu sedis quatuor animalia plena oculis ante et retro.
text_pt: E havia diante do trono um como mar de vidro, semelhante ao cristal. E no meio do trono, e ao redor do trono, quatro animais cheios de olhos, por diante e por detrás.
text_el: καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ὡς θάλασσα ὑαλίνη ὁμοία κρυστάλλῳ. καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου τέσσαρα ζῷα γέμοντα ὀφθαλμῶν ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν:

text_en: And the first living creature was like a lion: and the second living creature like a calf: and the third living creature, having the face, as it were, of a man : and the fourth living creature was like an eagle flying.
text_la: Et animal primum simile leoni, et secundum animal simile vitulo, et tertium animal habens faciem quasi hominis, et quartum animal simile aquilæ volanti.
text_pt: E o primeiro animal era semelhante a um leão, e o segundo animal semelhante a um bezerro, e tinha o terceiro animal o rosto como de homem, e o quarto animal era semelhante a uma águia voando.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ζῷον τὸ πρῶτον ὅμοιον λέοντι, καὶ τὸ δεύτερον ζῷον ὅμοιον μόσχῳ, καὶ τὸ τρίτον ζῷον ἔχων τὸ πρόσωπον ὡς ἀνθρώπου, καὶ τὸ τέταρτον ζῷον ὅμοιον ἀετῷ πετομένῳ.

text_en: And the four living creatures had each of them six wings: and round about and within they are full of eyes. And they rested not day and night, saying: Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come.
text_la: Et quatuor animalia, singula eorum habebant alas senas : et in circuitu, et intus plena sunt oculis : et requiem non habebant die ac nocte, dicentia : Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus Dominus Deus omnipotens, qui erat, et qui est, et qui venturus est.
text_pt: E os quatro animais tinham, cada um de per si, seis asas, e ao redor, e por dentro, estavam cheios de olhos; e não descansam nem de dia nem de noite, dizendo: Santo, Santo, Santo, é o Senhor Deus, o Todo-Poderoso, que era, e que é, e que há de vir.
text_el: καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα, ἓν καθ' ἓν αὐτῶν ἔχων ἀνὰ πτέρυγας ἕξ, κυκλόθεν καὶ ἔσωθεν γέμουσιν ὀφθαλμῶν: καὶ ἀνάπαυσιν οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς λέγοντες, ἅγιος ἅγιος ἅγιος κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ὁ ἦν καὶ ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἐρχόμενος.

text_en: And when those living creatures gave glory and honour and benediction to him that sits on the throne, who lives for ever and ever:
text_la: Et cum darent illa animalia gloriam, et honorem, et benedictionem sedenti super thronum, viventi in sæcula sæculorum,
text_pt: E, quando os animais davam glória, e honra, e ações de graças ao que estava assentado sobre o trono, ao que vive para todo o sempre,
text_el: καὶ ὅταν δώσουσιν τὰ ζῷα δόξαν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ εὐχαριστίαν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου, τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων,

text_en: The four and twenty ancients fell down before him that sits on the throne and adored him that lives for ever and ever and cast their crowns before the throne, saying:
text_la: procidebant viginti quatuor seniores ante sedentem in throno, et adorabant viventem in sæcula sæculorum, et mittebant coronas suas ante thronum, dicentes:
text_pt: Os vinte e quatro anciãos prostravam-se diante do que estava assentado sobre o trono, e adoravam o que vive para todo o sempre; e lançavam as suas coroas diante do trono, dizendo:
text_el: πεσοῦνται οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἐνώπιον τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ ζῶντι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, καὶ βαλοῦσιν τοὺς στεφάνους αὐτῶν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου λέγοντες,

text_en: You are worthy, O Lord our God , to receive glory and honour and power. Because you have created all things: and for your will they were and have been created.
text_la: Dignus es Domine Deus noster accipere gloriam, et honorem, et virtutem : quia tu creasti omnia, et propter voluntatem tuam erant, et creata sunt.
text_pt: Digno és, Senhor, de receber glória, e honra, e poder; porque tu criaste todas as coisas, e por tua vontade são e foram criadas.
text_el: ἄξιος εἶ, ὁ κύριος καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν, λαβεῖν τὴν δόξαν καὶ τὴν τιμὴν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν, ὅτι σὺ ἔκτισας τὰ πάντα, καὶ διὰ τὸ θέλημά σου ἦσαν καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν.

text_en: And I saw, in the right hand of him that sat on the throne, a book, written within and without, sealed with seven seals.
text_la: Et vidi in dextera sedentis supra thronum, librum scriptum intus et foris, signatum sigillis septem.
text_pt: E vi na destra do que estava assentado sobre o trono um livro escrito por dentro e por fora, selado com sete selos.
text_el: Καὶ εἶδον ἐπὶ τὴν δεξιὰν τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου βιβλίον γεγραμμένον ἔσωθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν, κατεσφραγισμένον σφραγῖσιν ἑπτά.

text_en: And I saw a strong angel , proclaiming with a loud voice: Who is worthy to open the book and to loose the seals thereof?
text_la: Et vidi angelum fortem, prædicantem voce magna : Quis est dignus aperire librum, et solvere signacula ejus?
text_pt: E vi um anjo forte, bradando com grande voz: Quem é digno de abrir o livro e de desatar os seus selos?
text_el: καὶ εἶδον ἄγγελον ἰσχυρὸν κηρύσσοντα ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, τίς ἄξιος ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ λῦσαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ;

text_en: And no man was able, neither in heaven nor on earth nor under the earth, to open the book, nor to look on it.
text_la: Et nemo poterat neque in cælo, neque in terra, neque subtus terram aperire librum, neque respicere illum.
text_pt: E ninguém no céu, nem na terra, nem debaixo da terra, podia abrir o livro, nem olhar para ele.
text_el: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐδὲ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό.

text_en: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open the book, nor to see it.
text_la: Et ego flebam multum, quoniam nemo dignus inventus est aperire librum, nec videre eum.
text_pt: E eu chorava muito, porque ninguém fora achado digno de abrir o livro, nem de o ler, nem de olhar para ele.
text_el: καὶ [ἐγὼ] ἔκλαιον πολὺ ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἄξιος εὑρέθη ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό.

text_en: And one of the ancients said to me: Weep not: behold the lion of the tribe of Juda , the root of David , has prevailed to open the book and to loose the seven seals thereof.
text_la: Et unus de senioribus dixit mihi : Ne fleveris : ecce vicit leo de tribu Juda, radix David, aperire librum, et solvere septem signacula ejus.
text_pt: E disse-me um dos anciãos: Não chores; eis aqui o Leão da tribo de Judá, a raiz de Davi, que venceu, para abrir o livro e desatar os seus sete selos.
text_el: καὶ εἷς ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων λέγει μοι, μὴ κλαῖε: ἰδοὺ ἐνίκησεν ὁ λέων ὁ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ἰούδα, ἡ ῥίζα Δαυίδ, ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And I saw: and behold in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures and in the midst of the ancients, a Lamb standing, as it were slain, having seven horns and seven eyes: which are the seven Spirits of God , sent forth into all the earth.
text_la: Et vidi : et ecce in medio throni et quatuor animalium, et in medio seniorum, Agnum stantem tamquam occisum, habentem cornua septem, et oculos septem : qui sunt septem spiritus Dei, missi in omnem terram.
text_pt: E olhei, e eis que estava no meio do trono e dos quatro animais viventes e entre os anciãos um Cordeiro, como havendo sido morto, e tinha sete pontas e sete olhos, que são os sete espíritos de Deus enviados a toda a terra.
text_el: Καὶ εἶδον ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων ἀρνίον ἑστηκὸς ὡς ἐσφαγμένον, ἔχων κέρατα ἑπτὰ καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς ἑπτά, οἵ εἰσιν τὰ ἑπτὰ πνεύματα τοῦ θεοῦ ἀπεσταλμένοι εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν.

text_en: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat on the throne.
text_la: Et venit: et accepit de dextera sedentis in throno librum.
text_pt: E veio, e tomou o livro da destra do que estava assentado no trono.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν καὶ εἴληφεν ἐκ τῆς δεξιᾶς τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου.

text_en: And when he had opened the book, the four living creatures and the four and twenty ancients fell down before the Lamb , having every one of them harps and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints .
text_la: Et cum aperuisset librum, quatuor animalia, et viginti quatuor seniores ceciderunt coram Agno, habentes singuli citharas, et phialas aureas plenas odoramentorum, quæ sunt orationes sanctorum:
text_pt: E, havendo tomado o livro, os quatro animais e os vinte e quatro anciãos prostraram-se diante do Cordeiro, tendo todos eles harpas e salvas de ouro cheias de incenso, que são as orações dos santos.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἔλαβεν τὸ βιβλίον, τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα καὶ οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἀρνίου, ἔχοντες ἕκαστος κιθάραν καὶ φιάλας χρυσᾶς γεμούσας θυμιαμάτων, αἵ εἰσιν αἱ προσευχαὶ τῶν ἁγίων.

text_en: And they sung a new canticle, saying: You are worthy, O Lord, to take the book and to open the seals thereof: because you were slain and have redeemed us to God , in your blood, out of every tribe and tongue and people and nation:
text_la: et cantabant canticum novum, dicentes : Dignus es, Domine, accipere librum, et aperire signacula ejus : quoniam occisus es, et redemisti nos Deo in sanguine tuo ex omni tribu, et lingua, et populo, et natione:
text_pt: E cantavam um novo cântico, dizendo: Digno és de tomar o livro, e de abrir os seus selos; porque foste morto, e com o teu sangue nos compraste para Deus de toda a tribo, e língua, e povo, e nação;
text_el: καὶ ᾄδουσιν ᾠδὴν καινὴν λέγοντες, ἄξιος εἶ λαβεῖν τὸ βιβλίον καὶ ἀνοῖξαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐσφάγης καὶ ἠγόρασας τῷ θεῷ ἐν τῷ αἵματί σου ἐκ πάσης φυλῆς καὶ γλώσσης καὶ λαοῦ καὶ ἔθνους,

text_en: And have made us to our God a kingdom and priests , and we shall reign on the earth.
text_la: et fecisti nos Deo nostro regnum, et sacerdotes : et regnabimus super terram.
text_pt: E para o nosso Deus nos fizeste reis e sacerdotes; e reinaremos sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησας αὐτοὺς τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν βασιλείαν καὶ ἱερεῖς, καὶ βασιλεύουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

text_en: And I beheld, and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the living creatures and the ancients (and the number of them was thousands of thousands),
text_la: Et vidi, et audivi vocem angelorum multorum in circuitu throni, et animalium, et seniorum : et erat numerus eorum millia millium,
text_pt: E olhei, e ouvi a voz de muitos anjos ao redor do trono, e dos animais, e dos anciãos; e era o número deles milhões de milhões, e milhares de milhares,
text_el: καὶ εἶδον, καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν ἀγγέλων πολλῶν κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν ζῴων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, καὶ ἦν ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν μυριάδες μυριάδων καὶ χιλιάδες χιλιάδων,

text_en: saying with a loud voice: The Lamb that was slain is worthy to receive power and divinity and wisdom and strength and honour and glory and benediction.
text_la: dicentium voce magna : Dignus est Agnus, qui occisus est, accipere virtutem, et divinitatem, et sapientiam, et fortitudinem, et honorem, et gloriam, et benedictionem.
text_pt: Que com grande voz diziam: Digno é o Cordeiro, que foi morto, de receber o poder, e riquezas, e sabedoria, e força, e honra, e glória, e ações de graças.
text_el: λέγοντες φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, ἄξιόν ἐστιν τὸ ἀρνίον τὸ ἐσφαγμένον λαβεῖν τὴν δύναμιν καὶ πλοῦτον καὶ σοφίαν καὶ ἰσχὺν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν καὶ εὐλογίαν.

text_en: And every creature which is in heaven and on the earth and under the earth, and such as are in the sea, and all that are in them, I heard all saying: To him that sits on the throne and to the Lamb , benediction and honour and glory and power, for ever and ever.
text_la: Et omnem creaturam, quæ in cælo est, et super terram, et sub terra, et quæ sunt in mari, et quæ in eo : omnes audivi dicentes : Sedenti in throno, et Agno, benedictio et honor, et gloria, et potestas in sæcula sæculorum.
text_pt: E ouvi a toda a criatura que está no céu, e na terra, e debaixo da terra, e que estão no mar, e a todas as coisas que neles há, dizer: Ao que está assentado sobre o trono, e ao Cordeiro, sejam dadas ações de graças, e honra, e glória, e poder para todo o sempre.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν κτίσμα ὃ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης, [ἐστίν] καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς πάντα ἤκουσα λέγοντας, τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῷ ἀρνίῳ ἡ εὐλογία καὶ ἡ τιμὴ καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.

text_en: And the four living creatures said: Amen . And the four and twenty ancients fell down on their faces and adored him that lives for ever and ever.
text_la: Et quatuor animalia dicebant : Amen. Et viginti quatuor seniores ceciderunt in facies suas : et adoraverunt viventem in sæcula sæculorum.
text_pt: E os quatro animais diziam: Amém. E os vinte e quatro anciãos prostraram-se, e adoraram ao que vive para todo o sempre.
text_el: καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα ἔλεγον, ἀμήν: καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν καὶ προσεκύνησαν.

text_en: And I saw that the Lamb had opened one of the seven seals: and I heard one of the four living creatures, as it were the voice of thunder, saying: Come and see.
text_la: Et vidi quod aperuisset Agnus unum de septem sigillis, et audivi unum de quatuor animalibus, dicens tamquam vocem tonitrui : Veni, et vide.
text_pt: E, havendo o Cordeiro aberto um dos selos, olhei, e ouvi um dos quatro animais, que dizia como em voz de trovão: Vem, e vê.
text_el: Καὶ εἶδον ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὸ ἀρνίον μίαν ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ σφραγίδων, καὶ ἤκουσα ἑνὸς ἐκ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων λέγοντος ὡς φωνὴ βροντῆς, ἔρχου.

text_en: And I saw: and behold a white horse, and he that sat on him had a bow, and there was a crown given him, and he went forth conquering that he might conquer.
text_la: Et vidi : et ecce equus albus, et qui sedebat super illum, habebat arcum, et data est ei corona, et exivit vincens ut vinceret.
text_pt: E olhei, e eis um cavalo branco; e o que estava assentado sobre ele tinha um arco; e foi-lhe dada uma coroa, e saiu vitorioso, e para vencer.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος λευκός, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἔχων τόξον, καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ στέφανος, καὶ ἐξῆλθεν νικῶν καὶ ἵνα νικήσῃ.

text_en: And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying: Come and see.
text_la: Et cum aperuisset sigillum secundum, audivi secundum animal, dicens : Veni, et vide.
text_pt: E, havendo aberto o segundo selo, ouvi o segundo animal, dizendo: Vem, e vê.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν δευτέραν, ἤκουσα τοῦ δευτέρου ζῴου λέγοντος, ἔρχου.

text_en: And there went out another horse that was red. And to him that sat thereon, it was given that he should take peace from the earth: and that they should kill one another. And a great sword was given to him.
text_la: Et exivit alius equus rufus : et qui sedebat super illum, datum est ei ut sumeret pacem de terra, et ut invicem se interficiant, et datus est ei gladius magnus.
text_pt: E saiu outro cavalo, vermelho; e ao que estava assentado sobre ele foi dado que tirasse a paz da terra, e que se matassem uns aos outros; e foi-lhe dada uma grande espada.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἄλλος ἵππος πυρρός, καὶ τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἐδόθη [αὐτῷ] λαβεῖν τὴν εἰρήνην [ἐκ] τῆς γῆς καὶ ἵνα ἀλλήλους σφάξουσιν, καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ μάχαιρα μεγάλη.

text_en: And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying: Come and see. And behold a black horse. And he that sat on him had a pair of scales in his hand.
text_la: Et cum aperuisset sigillum tertium, audivi tertium animal, dicens : Veni, et vide. Et ecce equus niger : et qui sedebat super illum, habebat stateram in manu sua.
text_pt: E, havendo aberto o terceiro selo, ouvi dizer o terceiro animal: Vem, e vê. E olhei, e eis um cavalo preto e o que sobre ele estava assentado tinha uma balança em sua mão.
text_el: Καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν τρίτην, ἤκουσα τοῦ τρίτου ζῴου λέγοντος: ἔρχου. καὶ εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος μέλας, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπ' αὐτὸν ἔχων ζυγὸν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And I heard, as it were a voice in the midst of the four living creatures, saying: Two pounds of wheat for a penny, and thrice two pounds of barley for a penny: and see that you hurt not the wine and the oil.
text_la: Et audivi tamquam vocem in medio quatuor animalium dicentium : Bilibris tritici denario et tres bilibres hordei denario, et vinum, et oleum ne læseris.
text_pt: E ouvi uma voz no meio dos quatro animais, que dizia: Uma medida de trigo por um dinheiro, e três medidas de cevada por um dinheiro; e não danifiques o azeite e o vinho.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσα ὡς φωνὴν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων λέγουσαν, χοῖνιξ σίτου δηναρίου, καὶ τρεῖς χοίνικες κριθῶν δηναρίου: καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον καὶ τὸν οἶνον μὴ ἀδικήσῃς.

text_en: And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying: Come and see.
text_la: Et cum aperuisset sigillum quartum, audivi vocem quarti animalis dicentis : Veni, et vide.
text_pt: E, havendo aberto o quarto selo, ouvi a voz do quarto animal, que dizia: Vem, e vê.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν τετάρτην, ἤκουσα φωνὴν τοῦ τετάρτου ζῴου λέγοντος, ἔρχου.

text_en: And behold a pale horse: and he that sat upon him, his name was Death. And hell followed him. And power was given to him over the four parts of the earth, to kill with sword, with famine and with death and with the beasts of the earth.
text_la: Et ecce equus pallidus : et qui sedebat super eum, nomen illi Mors, et infernus sequebatur eum, et data est illi potestas super quatuor partes terræ, interficere gladio, fame, et morte, et bestiis terræ.
text_pt: E olhei, e eis um cavalo amarelo, e o que estava assentado sobre ele tinha por nome Morte; e o inferno o seguia; e foi-lhes dado poder para matar a quarta parte da terra, com espada, e com fome, e com peste, e com as feras da terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος χλωρός, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπάνω [αὐτοῦ] ὄνομα αὐτῷ [ὁ] θάνατος, καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἠκολούθει μετ' αὐτοῦ: καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἐξουσία ἐπὶ τὸ τέταρτον τῆς γῆς, ἀποκτεῖναι ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ καὶ ἐν θανάτῳ καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν θηρίων τῆς γῆς.

text_en: And when he had opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of God and for the testimony which they held.
text_la: Et cum aperuisset sigillum quintum, vidi subtus altare animas interfectorum propter verbum Dei, et propter testimonium, quod habebant:
text_pt: E, havendo aberto o quinto selo, vi debaixo do altar as almas dos que foram mortos por amor da palavra de Deus e por amor do testemunho que deram.
text_el: καὶ ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν πέμπτην σφραγῖδα, εἶδον ὑποκάτω τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν ἐσφαγμένων διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ διὰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἣν εἶχον.

text_en: And they cried with a loud voice, saying: How long, O Lord (Holy and True ), do you not judge and revenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?
text_la: et clamabant voce magna, dicentes : Usquequo Domine (sanctus et verus), non judicas, et non vindicas sanguinem nostrum de iis qui habitant in terra?
text_pt: E clamavam com grande voz, dizendo: Até quando, ó verdadeiro e santo Dominador, não julgas e vingas o nosso sangue dos que habitam sobre a terra?
text_el: καὶ ἔκραξαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγοντες, ἕως πότε, ὁ δεσπότης ὁ ἅγιος καὶ ἀληθινός, οὐ κρίνεις καὶ ἐκδικεῖς τὸ αἷμα ἡμῶν ἐκ τῶν κατοικούντων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς;

text_en: And white robes were given to every one of them one; And it was said to them that they should rest for a little time till their fellow servants and their brethren, who are to be slain even as they, should be filled up.
text_la: Et datæ sunt illis singulæ stolæ albæ : et dictum est illis ut requiescerent adhuc tempus modicum donec compleantur conservi eorum, et fratres eorum, qui interficiendi sunt sicut et illi.
text_pt: E foram dadas a cada um compridas vestes brancas e foi-lhes dito que repousassem ainda um pouco de tempo, até que também se completasse o número de seus conservos e seus irmãos, que haviam de ser mortos como eles foram.
text_el: καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἑκάστῳ στολὴ λευκή, καὶ ἐρρέθη αὐτοῖς ἵνα ἀναπαύσονται ἔτι χρόνον μικρόν, ἕως πληρωθῶσιν καὶ οἱ σύνδουλοι αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν οἱ μέλλοντες ἀποκτέννεσθαι ὡς καὶ αὐτοί.

text_en: And I saw, when he had opened the sixth seal: and behold there was a great earthquake. And the sun became black as sackcloth of hair : and the whole moon became as blood.
text_la: Et vidi cum aperuisset sigillum sextum : et ecce terræmotus magnus factus est, et sol factus est niger tamquam saccus cilicinus : et luna tota facta est sicut sanguis:
text_pt: E, havendo aberto o sexto selo, olhei, e eis que houve um grande tremor de terra; e o sol tornou-se negro como saco de cilício, e a lua tornou-se como sangue;
text_el: Καὶ εἶδον ὅτε ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν ἕκτην, καὶ σεισμὸς μέγας ἐγένετο, καὶ ὁ ἥλιος ἐγένετο μέλας ὡς σάκκος τρίχινος, καὶ ἡ σελήνη ὅλη ἐγένετο ὡς αἷμα,

text_en: And the stars from heaven fell upon the earth, as the fig tree casts its green figs when it is shaken by a great wind.
text_la: et stellæ de cælo ceciderunt super terram, sicut ficus emittit grossos suos cum a vento magno movetur:
text_pt: E as estrelas do céu caíram sobre a terra, como quando a figueira lança de si os seus figos verdes, abalada por um vento forte.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἀστέρες τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἔπεσαν εἰς τὴν γῆν, ὡς συκῆ βάλλει τοὺς ὀλύνθους αὐτῆς ὑπὸ ἀνέμου μεγάλου σειομένη,

text_en: And the heaven departed as a book folded up. And every mountain, and the islands, were moved out of their places.
text_la: et cælum recessit sicut liber involutus : et omnis mons, et insulæ de locis suis motæ sunt:
text_pt: E o céu retirou-se como um livro que se enrola; e todos os montes e ilhas foram removidos dos seus lugares.
text_el: καὶ ὁ οὐρανὸς ἀπεχωρίσθη ὡς βιβλίον ἑλισσόμενον, καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ νῆσος ἐκ τῶν τόπων αὐτῶν ἐκινήθησαν.

text_en: And the kings of the earth and the princes and tribunes and the rich and the strong and every bondman and every freeman hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of mountains:
text_la: et reges terræ, et principes, et tribuni, et divites, et fortes, et omnis servus, et liber absconderunt se in speluncis, et in petris montium:
text_pt: E os reis da terra, e os grandes, e os ricos, e os tribunos, e os poderosos, e todo o servo, e todo o livre, se esconderam nas cavernas e nas rochas das montanhas;
text_el: καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ οἱ μεγιστᾶνες καὶ οἱ χιλίαρχοι καὶ οἱ πλούσιοι καὶ οἱ ἰσχυροὶ καὶ πᾶς δοῦλος καὶ ἐλεύθερος ἔκρυψαν ἑαυτοὺς εἰς τὰ σπήλαια καὶ εἰς τὰς πέτρας τῶν ὀρέων:

text_en: And they say to the mountains and the rocks: Fall upon us and hide us from the face of him that sits upon the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb .
text_la: et dicunt montibus, et petris : Cadite super nos, et abscondite nos a facie sedentis super thronum, et ab ira Agni:
text_pt: E diziam aos montes e aos rochedos: Caí sobre nós, e escondei-nos do rosto daquele que está assentado sobre o trono, e da ira do Cordeiro;
text_el: καὶ λέγουσιν τοῖς ὄρεσιν καὶ ταῖς πέτραις, πέσετε ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καὶ κρύψατε ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς ὀργῆς τοῦ ἀρνίου,

text_en: For the great day of their wrath has come. And who shall be able to stand?
text_la: quoniam venit dies magnus iræ ipsorum : et quis poterit stare?
text_pt: Porque é vindo o grande dia da sua ira; e quem poderá subsistir?
text_el: ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ἡμέρα ἡ μεγάλη τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτῶν, καὶ τίς δύναται σταθῆναι;

text_en: After these things, I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that they should not blow upon the earth nor upon the sea nor on any tree.
text_la: Post hæc vidi quatuor angelos stantes super quatuor angulos terræ, tenentes quatuor ventos terræ, ne flarent super terram, neque super mare, neque in ullam arborem.
text_pt: E depois destas coisas vi quatro anjos que estavam sobre os quatro cantos da terra, retendo os quatro ventos da terra, para que nenhum vento soprasse sobre a terra, nem sobre o mar, nem contra árvore alguma.
text_el: μετὰ τοῦτο εἶδον τέσσαρας ἀγγέλους ἑστῶτας ἐπὶ τὰς τέσσαρας γωνίας τῆς γῆς, κρατοῦντας τοὺς τέσσαρας ἀνέμους τῆς γῆς, ἵνα μὴ πνέῃ ἄνεμος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς μήτε ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης μήτε ἐπὶ πᾶν δένδρον.

text_en: And I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, having the sign of the living God . And he cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,
text_la: Et vidi alterum angelum ascendentem ab ortu solis, habentem signum Dei vivi : et clamavit voce magna quatuor angelis, quibus datum est nocere terræ et mari,
text_pt: E vi outro anjo subir do lado do sol nascente, e que tinha o selo do Deus vivo; e clamou com grande voz aos quatro anjos, a quem fora dado o poder de danificar a terra e o mar,
text_el: καὶ εἶδον ἄλλον ἄγγελον ἀναβαίνοντα ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς ἡλίου, ἔχοντα σφραγῖδα θεοῦ ζῶντος, καὶ ἔκραξεν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ τοῖς τέσσαρσιν ἀγγέλοις οἷς ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἀδικῆσαι τὴν γῆν καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν,

text_en: saying: Hurt not the earth nor the sea nor the trees, till we sign the servants of our God in their foreheads.
text_la: dicens : Nolite nocere terræ, et mari, neque arboribus, quoadusque signemus servos Dei nostri in frontibus eorum.
text_pt: Dizendo: Não danifiqueis a terra, nem o mar, nem as árvores, até que hajamos selado nas suas testas os servos do nosso Deus.
text_el: λέγων, μὴ ἀδικήσητε τὴν γῆν μήτε τὴν θάλασσαν μήτε τὰ δένδρα ἄχρι σφραγίσωμεν τοὺς δούλους τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν.

text_en: And I heard the number of them that were signed. An hundred forty-four thousand were signed, of every tribe of the children of Israel .
text_la: Et audivi numerum signatorum, centum quadraginta quatuor millia signati, ex omni tribu filiorum Israël.
text_pt: E ouvi o número dos selados, e eram cento e quarenta e quatro mil selados, de todas as tribos dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσα τὸν ἀριθμὸν τῶν ἐσφραγισμένων, ἑκατὸν τεσσεράκοντα τέσσαρες χιλιάδες ἐσφραγισμένοι ἐκ πάσης φυλῆς υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ:

text_en: Of the tribe of Juda , twelve thousand signed: Of the tribe of Ruben , twelve thousand signed: Of the tribe of Gad , twelve thousand signed:
text_la: Ex tribu Juda duodecim millia signati : ex tribu Ruben duodecim millia signati : ex tribu Gad duodecim millia signati:
text_pt: Da tribo de Judá, havia doze mil selados; da tribo de Rúbem, doze mil selados; da tribo de Gade, doze mil selados;
text_el: ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰούδα δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐσφραγισμένοι, ἐκ φυλῆς Ῥουβὴν δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Γὰδ δώδεκα χιλιάδες,

text_en: Of the tribe of Aser , twelve thousand signed: Of the tribe of Nephthali , twelve thousand signed: Of the tribe of Manasses , twelve thousand signed:
text_la: ex tribu Aser duodecim millia signati : ex tribu Nephthali duodecim millia signati : ex tribu Manasse duodecim millia signati:
text_pt: Da tribo de Aser, doze mil selados; da tribo de Naftali, doze mil selados; da tribo de Manassés, doze mil selados;
text_el: ἐκ φυλῆς Ἀσὴρ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Νεφθαλὶμ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Μανασσῆ δώδεκα χιλιάδες,

text_en: Of the tribe of Simeon , twelve thousand signed: Of the tribe of Levi , twelve thousand signed: Of the tribe of Issachar , twelve thousand signed:
text_la: ex tribu Simeon duodecim millia signati : ex tribu Levi duodecim millia signati : ex tribu Issachar duodecim millia signati:
text_pt: Da tribo de Simeão, doze mil selados; da tribo de Levi, doze mil selados; da tribo de Issacar, doze mil selados;
text_el: ἐκ φυλῆς Συμεὼν δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Λευὶ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰσσαχὰρ δώδεκα χιλιάδες,

text_en: Of the tribe of Zabulon , twelve thousand signed: Of the tribe of Joseph , twelve thousand signed: Of the tribe of Benjamin , twelve thousand signed.
text_la: ex tribu Zabulon duodecim millia signati : ex tribu Joseph duodecim millia signati : ex tribu Benjamin duodecim millia signati.
text_pt: Da tribo de Zebulom, doze mil selados; da tribo de José, doze mil selados; da tribo de Benjamim, doze mil selados.
text_el: ἐκ φυλῆς Ζαβουλὼν δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Ἰωσὴφ δώδεκα χιλιάδες, ἐκ φυλῆς Βενιαμὶν δώδεκα χιλιάδες ἐσφραγισμένοι.

text_en: After this, I saw a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations and tribes and peoples and tongues, standing before the throne and in sight of the Lamb , clothed with white robes, and palms in their hands.
text_la: Post hæc vidi turbam magnam, quam dinumerare nemo poterat, ex omnibus gentibus, et tribubus, et populis, et linguis : stantes ante thronum, et in conspectu Agni, amicti stolis albis, et palmæ in manibus eorum:
text_pt: Depois destas coisas olhei, e eis aqui uma multidão, a qual ninguém podia contar, de todas as nações, e tribos, e povos, e línguas, que estavam diante do trono, e perante o Cordeiro, trajando vestes brancas e com palmas nas suas mãos;
text_el: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον, καὶ ἰδοὺ ὄχλος πολύς, ὃν ἀριθμῆσαι αὐτὸν οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο, ἐκ παντὸς ἔθνους καὶ φυλῶν καὶ λαῶν καὶ γλωσσῶν, ἑστῶτες ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου καὶ ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἀρνίου, περιβεβλημένους στολὰς λευκάς, καὶ φοίνικες ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν:

text_en: And they cried with a loud voice, saying: Salvation to our God , who sits upon the throne and to the Lamb .
text_la: et clamabant voce magna, dicentes : Salus Deo nostro, qui sedet super thronum, et Agno.
text_pt: E clamavam com grande voz, dizendo: Salvação ao nosso Deus, que está assentado no trono, e ao Cordeiro.
text_el: καὶ κράζουσιν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγοντες, ἡ σωτηρία τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ καὶ τῷ ἀρνίῳ.

text_en: And all the angels stood round about the throne and the ancients and the four living creatures. And they fell down before the throne upon their faces and adored God ,
text_la: Et omnes angeli stabant in circuitu throni, et seniorum, et quatuor animalium : et ceciderunt in conspectu throni in facies suas, et adoraverunt Deum,
text_pt: E todos os anjos estavam ao redor do trono, e dos anciãos, e dos quatro animais; e prostraram-se diante do trono sobre seus rostos, e adoraram a Deus,
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄγγελοι εἱστήκεισαν κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων, καὶ ἔπεσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου ἐπὶ τὰ πρόσωπα αὐτῶν καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ θεῷ,

text_en: saying: Amen . Benediction and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving, honour and power and strength, to our God , for ever and ever. Amen .
text_la: dicentes : Amen. Benedictio, et claritas, et sapientia, et gratiarum actio, honor, et virtus, et fortitudo Deo nostro in sæcula sæculorum. Amen.
text_pt: Dizendo: Amém. Louvor, e glória, e sabedoria, e ação de graças, e honra, e poder, e força ao nosso Deus, para todo o sempre. Amém.
text_el: λέγοντες, ἀμήν: ἡ εὐλογία καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ ἡ σοφία καὶ ἡ εὐχαριστία καὶ ἡ τιμὴ καὶ ἡ δύναμις καὶ ἡ ἰσχὺς τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων: [ἀμήν].

text_en: And one of the ancients answered and said to me: These that are clothed in white robes, who are they? And whence came they?
text_la: Et respondit unus de senioribus et dixit mihi : Hi, qui amicti sunt stolis albis, qui sunt? et unde venerunt?
text_pt: E um dos anciãos me falou, dizendo: Estes que estão vestidos de vestes brancas, quem são, e de onde vieram?
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκρίθη εἷς ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων λέγων μοι, οὗτοι οἱ περιβεβλημένοι τὰς στολὰς τὰς λευκὰς τίνες εἰσὶν καὶ πόθεν ἦλθον;

text_en: And I said to him: My Lord, you know . And he said to me: These are they who have come out of great tribulation and have washed their robes and have made them white in the blood of the Lamb .
text_la: Et dixi illi : Domine mi, tu scis. Et dixit mihi : Hi sunt, qui venerunt de tribulatione magna, et laverunt stolas suas, et dealbaverunt eas in sanguine Agni.
text_pt: E eu disse-lhe: Senhor, tu sabes. E ele disse-me: Estes são os que vieram da grande tribulação, e lavaram as suas vestes e as branquearam no sangue do Cordeiro.
text_el: καὶ εἴρηκα αὐτῷ, κύριέ μου, σὺ οἶδας. καὶ εἶπέν μοι, οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἐρχόμενοι ἐκ τῆς θλίψεως τῆς μεγάλης, καὶ ἔπλυναν τὰς στολὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλεύκαναν αὐτὰς ἐν τῷ αἵματι τοῦ ἀρνίου.

text_en: Therefore, they are before the throne of God : and they serve him day and night in his temple . And he that sits on the throne shall dwell over them.
text_la: Ideo sunt ante thronum Dei, et serviunt ei die ac nocte in templo ejus : et qui sedet in throno, habitabit super illos:
text_pt: Por isso estão diante do trono de Deus, e o servem de dia e de noite no seu templo; e aquele que está assentado sobre o trono os cobrirá com a sua sombra.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτό εἰσιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ λατρεύουσιν αὐτῷ ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς ἐν τῷ ναῷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου σκηνώσει ἐπ' αὐτούς.

text_en: They shall no more hunger nor thirst: neither shall the sun fall on them, nor any heat.
text_la: non esurient, neque sitient amplius, nec cadet super illos sol, neque ullus æstus:
text_pt: Nunca mais terão fome, nunca mais terão sede; nem sol nem calma alguma cairá sobre eles.
text_el: οὐ πεινάσουσιν ἔτι οὐδὲ διψήσουσιν ἔτι, οὐδὲ μὴ πέσῃ ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ὁ ἥλιος οὐδὲ πᾶν καῦμα,

text_en: For the Lamb , which is in the midst of the throne, shall rule them and shall lead them to the fountains of the waters of life: and God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes.
text_la: quoniam Agnus, qui in medio throni est, reget illos et deducet eos ad vitæ fontes aquarum, et absterget Deus omnem lacrimam ab oculis eorum.
text_pt: Porque o Cordeiro que está no meio do trono os apascentará, e lhes servirá de guia para as fontes vivas das águas; e Deus limpará de seus olhos toda a lágrima.
text_el: ὅτι τὸ ἀρνίον τὸ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ θρόνου ποιμανεῖ αὐτούς, καὶ ὁδηγήσει αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ ζωῆς πηγὰς ὑδάτων: καὶ ἐξαλείψει ὁ θεὸς πᾶν δάκρυον ἐκ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν.

text_en: And when he had opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven , as it were for half an hour.
text_la: Et cum aperuisset sigillum septimum, factum est silentium in cælo, quasi media hora.
text_pt: E, havendo aberto o sétimo selo, fez-se silêncio no céu quase por meia hora.
text_el: Καὶ ὅταν ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν ἑβδόμην, ἐγένετο σιγὴ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ὡς ἡμιώριον.

text_en: And I saw seven angels standing in the presence of God : and there were given to them seven trumpets.
text_la: Et vidi septem angelos stantes in conspectu Dei : et datæ sunt illis septem tubæ.
text_pt: E vi os sete anjos, que estavam diante de Deus, e foram-lhes dadas sete trombetas.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλους οἳ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ἑστήκασιν, καὶ ἐδόθησαν αὐτοῖς ἑπτὰ σάλπιγγες.

text_en: And another angel came and stood before the altar , having a golden censer : and there was given to him much incense , that he should offer of the prayers of all saints , upon the golden altar which is before the throne of God .
text_la: Et alius angelus venit, et stetit ante altare habens thuribulum aureum : et data sunt illi incensa multa, ut daret de orationibus sanctorum omnium super altare aureum, quod est ante thronum Dei.
text_pt: E veio outro anjo, e pôs-se junto ao altar, tendo um incensário de ouro; e foi-lhe dado muito incenso, para o pôr com as orações de todos os santos sobre o altar de ouro, que está diante do trono.
text_el: καὶ ἄλλος ἄγγελος ἦλθεν καὶ ἐστάθη ἐπὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ἔχων λιβανωτὸν χρυσοῦν, καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ θυμιάματα πολλὰ ἵνα δώσει ταῖς προσευχαῖς τῶν ἁγίων πάντων ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν τὸ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου.

text_en: And the smoke of the incense of the prayers of the saints ascended up before God from the hand of the angel .
text_la: Et ascendit fumus incensorum de orationibus sanctorum de manu angeli coram Deo.
text_pt: E a fumaça do incenso subiu com as orações dos santos desde a mão do anjo até diante de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη ὁ καπνὸς τῶν θυμιαμάτων ταῖς προσευχαῖς τῶν ἁγίων ἐκ χειρὸς τοῦ ἀγγέλου ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And the angel took the censer and filled it with the fire of the altar and cast it on the earth: and there were thunders and voices and lightnings and a great earthquake.
text_la: Et accepit angelus thuribulum, et implevit illud de igne altaris, et misit in terram : et facta sunt tonitrua, et voces, et fulgura, et terræmotus magnus.
text_pt: E o anjo tomou o incensário, e o encheu do fogo do altar, e o lançou sobre a terra; e houve depois vozes, e trovões, e relâmpagos e terremotos.
text_el: καὶ εἴληφεν ὁ ἄγγελος τὸν λιβανωτόν, καὶ ἐγέμισεν αὐτὸν ἐκ τοῦ πυρὸς τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ἔβαλεν εἰς τὴν γῆν: καὶ ἐγένοντο βρονταὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ ἀστραπαὶ καὶ σεισμός.

text_en: And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound the trumpet.
text_la: Et septem angeli, qui habebant septem tubas, præparaverunt se ut tuba canerent.
text_pt: E os sete anjos, que tinham as sete trombetas, prepararam-se para tocá-las.
