text_pt: E ouvi outro do altar, que dizia: Na verdade, ó Senhor Deus Todo-Poderoso, verdadeiros e justos são os teus juízos.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου λέγοντος, ναί, κύριε ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ, ἀληθιναὶ καὶ δίκαιαι αἱ κρίσεις σου.

text_en: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun. And it was given unto him to afflict men with heat and fire.
text_la: Et quartus angelus effudit phialam suam in solem, et datum est illi æstu affligere homines, et igni:
text_pt: E o quarto anjo derramou a sua taça sobre o sol, e foi-lhe permitido que abrasasse os homens com fogo.
text_el: καὶ ὁ τέταρτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ἥλιον: καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ καυματίσαι τοὺς ἀνθρώπους ἐν πυρί.

text_en: And men were scorched with great heat: and they blasphemed the name of God , who has power over these plagues. Neither did they penance to give him glory .
text_la: et æstuaverunt homines æstu magno, et blasphemaverunt nomen Dei habentis potestatem super has plagas, neque egerunt pœnitentiam ut darent illi gloriam.
text_pt: E os homens foram abrasados com grandes calores, e blasfemaram o nome de Deus, que tem poder sobre estas pragas; e não se arrependeram para lhe darem glória.
text_el: καὶ ἐκαυματίσθησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι καῦμα μέγα, καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ἔχοντος τὴν ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τὰς πληγὰς ταύτας, καὶ οὐ μετενόησαν δοῦναι αὐτῷ δόξαν.

text_en: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast. And his kingdom became dark: and they gnawed their tongues for pain.
text_la: Et quintus angelus effudit phialam suam super sedem bestiæ : et factum est regnum ejus tenebrosum, et commanducaverunt linguas suas præ dolore:
text_pt: E o quinto anjo derramou a sua taça sobre o trono da besta, e o seu reino se fez tenebroso; e eles mordiam as suas línguas de dor.
text_el: Καὶ ὁ πέμπτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν θρόνον τοῦ θηρίου: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ ἐσκοτωμένη, καὶ ἐμασῶντο τὰς γλώσσας αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ πόνου,

text_en: And they blasphemed the God of heaven , because of their pains and wounds: and did not penance for their works.
text_la: et blasphemaverunt Deum cæli præ doloribus, et vulneribus suis, et non egerunt pœnitentiam ex operibus suis.
text_pt: E por causa das suas dores, e por causa das suas chagas, blasfemaram do Deus do céu; e não se arrependeram das suas obras.
text_el: καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν τὸν θεὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐκ τῶν πόνων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἑλκῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐ μετενόησαν ἐκ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῶν.

text_en: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon that great river Euphrates and dried up the water thereof, that a way might be prepared for the kings from the rising of the sun.
text_la: Et sextus angelus effudit phialam suam in flumen illud magnum Euphraten : et siccavit aquam ejus, ut præpararetur via regibus ab ortu solis.
text_pt: E o sexto anjo derramou a sua taça sobre o grande rio Eufrates; e a sua água secou-se, para que se preparasse o caminho dos reis do oriente.
text_el: Καὶ ὁ ἕκτος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ποταμὸν τὸν μέγαν [τὸν] Εὐφράτην: καὶ ἐξηράνθη τὸ ὕδωρ αὐτοῦ, ἵνα ἑτοιμασθῇ ἡ ὁδὸς τῶν βασιλέων τῶν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς ἡλίου.

text_en: And I saw from the mouth of the dragon and from the mouth of the beast and from the mouth of the false prophet , three unclean spirits like frogs.
text_la: Et vidi de ore draconis, et de ore bestiæ, et de ore pseudoprophetæ spiritus tres immundos in modum ranarum.
text_pt: E da boca do dragão, e da boca da besta, e da boca do falso profeta vi sair três espíritos imundos, semelhantes a rãs.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ δράκοντος καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ θηρίου καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ ψευδοπροφήτου πνεύματα τρία ἀκάθαρτα ὡς βάτραχοι:

text_en: For they are the spirits of devils , working signs: and they go forth unto the kings of the whole earth, to gather them to battle against the great day of the Almighty God .
text_la: Sunt enim spiritus dæmoniorum facientes signa, et procedunt ad reges totius terræ congregare illos in prælium ad diem magnum omnipotentis Dei.
text_pt: Porque são espíritos de demônios, que fazem prodígios; os quais vão ao encontro dos reis da terra e de todo o mundo, para os congregar para a batalha, naquele grande dia do Deus Todo-Poderoso.
text_el: εἰσὶν γὰρ πνεύματα δαιμονίων ποιοῦντα σημεῖα, ἃ ἐκπορεύεται ἐπὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς τῆς οἰκουμένης ὅλης, συναγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν πόλεμον τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς μεγάλης τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ παντοκράτορος.

text_en: Behold, I come as a thief . Blessed is he that watches and keeps his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
text_la: Ecce venio sicut fur. Beatus qui vigilat, et custodit vestimenta sua, ne nudus ambulet, et videant turpitudinem ejus.
text_pt: Eis que venho como ladrão. Bem-aventurado aquele que vigia, e guarda as suas roupas, para que não ande nu, e não se vejam as suas vergonhas.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ὡς κλέπτης. μακάριος ὁ γρηγορῶν καὶ τηρῶν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ, ἵνα μὴ γυμνὸς περιπατῇ καὶ βλέπωσιν τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he shall gather them together into a place which in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
text_la: Et congregabit illos in locum qui vocatur hebraice Armagedon.
text_pt: E os congregaram no lugar que em hebreu se chama Armagedom.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν καλούμενον Ἑβραϊστὶ Ἁρμαγεδών.

text_en: And the seventh angel poured out his vial upon the air. And there came a great voice out of the temple from the throne, saying: It is done.
text_la: Et septimus angelus effudit phialam suam in aërem, et exivit vox magna de templo a throno, dicens : Factum est.
text_pt: E o sétimo anjo derramou a sua taça no ar, e saiu grande voz do templo do céu, do trono, dizendo: Está feito.
text_el: Καὶ ὁ ἕβδομος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ἀέρα: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν φωνὴ μεγάλη ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θρόνου λέγουσα, γέγονεν.

text_en: And there were lightnings and voices and thunders: and there was a great earthquake, such an one as never had been since men were upon the earth, such an earthquake, so great.
text_la: Et facta sunt fulgura, et voces, et tonitrua, et terræmotus factus est magnus, qualis numquam fuit ex quo homines fuerunt super terram : talis terræmotus, sic magnus.
text_pt: E houve vozes, e trovões, e relâmpagos, e houve um grande terremoto, como nunca houve desde que há homens sobre a terra; tal foi este tão grande terremoto.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί, καὶ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας οἷος οὐκ ἐγένετο ἀφ' οὗ ἄνθρωποι ἐγένοντο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τηλικοῦτος σεισμὸς οὕτω μέγας.

text_en: And the great city was divided into three parts: and the cities of the Gentiles fell. And great Babylon came in remembrance before God , to give her the cup of the wine of the indignation of his wrath .
text_la: Et facta est civitas magna in tres partes : et civitates gentium ceciderunt. Et Babylon magna venit in memoriam ante Deum, dare illi calicem vini indignationis iræ ejus.
text_pt: E a grande cidade fendeu-se em três partes, e as cidades das nações caíram; e da grande babilônia se lembrou Deus, para lhe dar o cálice do vinho da indignação da sua ira.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη εἰς τρία μέρη, καὶ αἱ πόλεις τῶν ἐθνῶν ἔπεσαν. καὶ Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη ἐμνήσθη ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ δοῦναι αὐτῇ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And every island fled away: and the mountains were not found.
text_la: Et omnis insula fugit, et montes non sunt inventi.
text_pt: E toda a ilha fugiu; e os montes não se acharam.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα νῆσος ἔφυγεν, καὶ ὄρη οὐχ εὑρέθησαν.

text_en: And great hail, like a talent, came down from heaven upon men : and men blasphemed God , for the plague of the hail: because it was exceeding great.
text_la: Et grando magna sicut talentum descendit de cælo in homines : et blasphemaverunt Deum homines propter plagam grandinis : quoniam magna facta est vehementer.
text_pt: E sobre os homens caiu do céu uma grande saraiva, pedras do peso de um talento; e os homens blasfemaram de Deus por causa da praga da saraiva; porque a sua praga era mui grande.
text_el: καὶ χάλαζα μεγάλη ὡς ταλαντιαία καταβαίνει ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους: καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι τὸν θεὸν ἐκ τῆς πληγῆς τῆς χαλάζης, ὅτι μεγάλη ἐστὶν ἡ πληγὴ αὐτῆς σφόδρα.

text_en: And there came one of the seven angels who had the seven vials and spoke with me, saying: Come, I will show you the condemnation of the great harlot, who sits upon many waters:
text_la: Et venit unus de septem angelis, qui habebant septem phialas, et locutus est mecum, dicens : Veni, ostendam tibi damnationem meretricis magnæ, quæ sedet super aquas multas,
text_pt: E veio um dos sete anjos que tinham as sete taças, e falou comigo, dizendo-me: Vem, mostrar-te-ei a condenação da grande prostituta que está assentada sobre muitas águas;
text_el: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἷς ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλων τῶν ἐχόντων τὰς ἑπτὰ φιάλας, καὶ ἐλάλησεν μετ' ἐμοῦ λέγων: δεῦρο, δείξω σοι τὸ κρίμα τῆς πόρνης τῆς μεγάλης τῆς καθημένης ἐπὶ ὑδάτων πολλῶν,

text_en: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication. And they who inhabit the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her whoredom.
text_la: cum qua fornicati sunt reges terræ, et inebriati sunt qui inhabitant terram de vino prostitutionis ejus.
text_pt: Com a qual fornicaram os reis da terra; e os que habitam na terra se embebedaram com o vinho da sua fornicação.
text_el: μεθ' ἧς ἐπόρνευσαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς, καὶ ἐμεθύσθησαν οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν γῆν ἐκ τοῦ οἴνου τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς.

text_en: And he took me away in spirit into the desert . And I saw a woman sitting upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy , having seven heads and ten horns.
text_la: Et abstulit me in spiritu in desertum. Et vidi mulierem sedentem super bestiam coccineam, plenam nominibus blasphemiæ, habentem capita septem, et cornua decem.
text_pt: E levou-me em espírito a um deserto, e vi uma mulher assentada sobre uma besta de cor de escarlata, que estava cheia de nomes de blasfêmia, e tinha sete cabeças e dez chifres.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήνεγκέν με εἰς ἔρημον ἐν πνεύματι. καὶ εἶδον γυναῖκα καθημένην ἐπὶ θηρίον κόκκινον, γέμοντα ὀνόματα βλασφημίας, ἔχων κεφαλὰς ἑπτὰ καὶ κέρατα δέκα.

text_en: And the woman was clothed round about with purple and scarlet, and gilt with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand, full of the abomination and filthiness of her fornication.
text_la: Et mulier erat circumdata purpura, et coccino, et inaurata auro, et lapide pretioso, et margaritis, habens poculum aureum in manu sua, plenum abominatione, et immunditia fornicationis ejus.
text_pt: E a mulher estava vestida de púrpura e de escarlata, e adornada com ouro, e pedras preciosas e pérolas; e tinha na sua mão um cálice de ouro cheio das abominações e da imundícia da sua fornicação;
text_el: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἦν περιβεβλημένη πορφυροῦν καὶ κόκκινον, καὶ κεχρυσωμένη χρυσίῳ καὶ λίθῳ τιμίῳ καὶ μαργαρίταις, ἔχουσα ποτήριον χρυσοῦν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτῆς γέμον βδελυγμάτων καὶ τὰ ἀκάθαρτα τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς,

text_en: And on her forehead a name was written: A mystery : Babylon the great, the mother of the fornications and the abominations of the earth.
text_la: Et in fronte ejus nomen scriptum : Mysterium : Babylon magna, mater fornicationum, et abominationum terræ.
text_pt: E na sua testa estava escrito o nome: Mistério, a grande babilônia, a mãe das prostituições e abominações da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον αὐτῆς ὄνομα γεγραμμένον, μυστήριον, Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη, ἡ μήτηρ τῶν πορνῶν καὶ τῶν βδελυγμάτων τῆς γῆς.

text_en: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus . And I wondered, when I had seen her, with great admiration.
text_la: Et vidi mulierem ebriam de sanguine sanctorum, et de sanguine martyrum Jesu. Et miratus sum cum vidissem illam admiratione magna.
text_pt: E vi que a mulher estava embriagada do sangue dos santos, e do sangue das testemunhas de Jesus. E, vendo-a eu, maravilhei-me com grande admiração.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον τὴν γυναῖκα μεθύουσαν ἐκ τοῦ αἵματος τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἐκ τοῦ αἵματος τῶν μαρτύρων Ἰησοῦ. καὶ ἐθαύμασα ἰδὼν αὐτὴν θαῦμα μέγα.

text_en: And the angel said to me: Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast which carries her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
text_la: Et dixit mihi angelus : Quare miraris? ego dicam tibi sacramentum mulieris, et bestiæ, quæ portat eam, quæ habet capita septem, et cornua decem.
text_pt: E o anjo me disse: Por que te admiras? Eu te direi o mistério da mulher, e da besta que a traz, a qual tem sete cabeças e dez chifres.
text_el: Καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ ἄγγελος, διὰ τί ἐθαύμασας; ἐγὼ ἐρῶ σοι τὸ μυστήριον τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ τοῦ θηρίου τοῦ βαστάζοντος αὐτήν, τοῦ ἔχοντος τὰς ἑπτὰ κεφαλὰς καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα:

text_en: The beast which you saw, was, and is not, and shall come up out of the bottomless pit and go into destruction. And the inhabitants on the earth (whose names are not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world) shall wonder, seeing the beast that was and is not.
text_la: Bestia, quam vidisti, fuit, et non est, et ascensura est de abysso, et in interitum ibit : et mirabuntur inhabitantes terram (quorum non sunt scripta nomina in libro vitæ a constitutione mundi) videntes bestiam, quæ erat, et non est.
text_pt: A besta que viste foi e já não é, e há de subir do abismo, e irá à perdição; e os que habitam na terra (cujos nomes não estão escritos no livro da vida, desde a fundação do mundo) se admirarão, vendo a besta que era e já não é, ainda que é.
text_el: τὸ θηρίον ὃ εἶδες ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν, καὶ μέλλει ἀναβαίνειν ἐκ τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ εἰς ἀπώλειαν ὑπάγει: καὶ θαυμασθήσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ὧν οὐ γέγραπται τὸ ὄνομα ἐπὶ τὸ βιβλίον τῆς ζωῆς ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, βλεπόντων τὸ θηρίον ὅτι ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ παρέσται.

text_en: And here is the understanding that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, upon which the woman sits: and they are seven kings.
text_la: Et hic est sensus, qui habet sapientiam. Septem capita, septem montes sunt, super quos mulier sedet, et reges septem sunt.
text_pt: Aqui o sentido, que tem sabedoria. As sete cabeças são sete montes, sobre os quais a mulher está assentada.
text_el: ὧδε ὁ νοῦς ὁ ἔχων σοφίαν. αἱ ἑπτὰ κεφαλαὶ ἑπτὰ ὄρη εἰσίν, ὅπου ἡ γυνὴ κάθηται ἐπ' αὐτῶν. καὶ βασιλεῖς ἑπτά εἰσιν:

text_en: Five are fallen, one is, and the other is not yet come: and when he has come, he must remain a short time.
text_la: Quinque ceciderunt, unus est, et alius nondum venit : et cum venerit, oportet illum breve tempus manere.
text_pt: E são também sete reis; cinco já caíram, e um existe; outro ainda não é vindo; e, quando vier, convém que dure um pouco de tempo.
text_el: οἱ πέντε ἔπεσαν, ὁ εἷς ἔστιν, ὁ ἄλλος οὔπω ἦλθεν, καὶ ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὀλίγον αὐτὸν δεῖ μεῖναι.

text_en: And the beast which was and is not: the same also is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goes into destruction.
text_la: Et bestia, quæ erat, et non est : et ipsa octava est : et de septem est, et in interitum vadit.
text_pt: E a besta que era e já não é, é ela também o oitavo, e é dos sete, e vai à perdição.
text_el: καὶ τὸ θηρίον ὃ ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν, καὶ αὐτὸς ὄγδοός ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἑπτά ἐστιν, καὶ εἰς ἀπώλειαν ὑπάγει.

text_en: And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, who have not yet received a kingdom: but shall receive power as kings, one hour after the beast.
text_la: Et decem cornua, quæ vidisti, decem reges sunt : qui regnum nondum acceperunt, sed potestatem tamquam reges una hora accipient post bestiam.
text_pt: E os dez chifres que viste são dez reis, que ainda não receberam o reino, mas receberão poder como reis por uma hora, juntamente com a besta.
text_el: καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα ἃ εἶδες δέκα βασιλεῖς εἰσιν, οἵτινες βασιλείαν οὔπω ἔλαβον, ἀλλὰ ἐξουσίαν ὡς βασιλεῖς μίαν ὥραν λαμβάνουσιν μετὰ τοῦ θηρίου.

text_en: These have one design: and their strength and power they shall deliver to the beast.
text_la: Hi unum consilium habent, et virtutem, et potestatem suam bestiæ tradent.
text_pt: Estes têm um mesmo intento, e entregarão o seu poder e autoridade à besta.
text_el: οὗτοι μίαν γνώμην ἔχουσιν, καὶ τὴν δύναμιν καὶ ἐξουσίαν αὐτῶν τῷ θηρίῳ διδόασιν.

text_en: These shall fight with the Lamb . And the Lamb shall overcome them because he is Lord of lords and King of kings: and they that are with him are called and elect and faithful.
text_la: Hi cum Agno pugnabunt, et Agnus vincet illos : quoniam Dominus dominorum est, et Rex regum, et qui cum illo sunt, vocati, electi, et fideles.
text_pt: Estes combaterão contra o Cordeiro, e o Cordeiro os vencerá, porque é o Senhor dos senhores e o Rei dos reis; vencerão os que estão com ele, chamados, e eleitos, e fiéis.
text_el: οὗτοι μετὰ τοῦ ἀρνίου πολεμήσουσιν, καὶ τὸ ἀρνίον νικήσει αὐτούς, ὅτι κύριος κυρίων ἐστὶν καὶ βασιλεὺς βασιλέων, καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ κλητοὶ καὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ καὶ πιστοί.

text_en: And he said to me: The waters which you saw, where the harlot sits, are peoples and nations and tongues.
text_la: Et dixit mihi : Aquæ, quas vidisti ubi meretrix sedet, populi sunt, et gentes, et linguæ.
text_pt: E disse-me: As águas que viste, onde se assenta a prostituta, são povos, e multidões, e nações, e línguas.
text_el: καὶ λέγει μοι, τὰ ὕδατα ἃ εἶδες, οὗ ἡ πόρνη κάθηται, λαοὶ καὶ ὄχλοι εἰσὶν καὶ ἔθνη καὶ γλῶσσαι.

text_en: And the ten horns which you saw in the beast: These shall hate the harlot and shall make her desolate and naked and shall eat her flesh and shall burn her with fire.
text_la: Et decem cornua, quæ vidisti in bestia : hi odient fornicariam, et desolatam facient illam, et nudam, et carnes ejus manducabunt, et ipsam igni concremabunt.
text_pt: E os dez chifres que viste na besta são os que odiarào a prostituta, e a colocarão desolada e nua, e comerão a sua carne, e a queimarão no fogo.
text_el: καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα ἃ εἶδες καὶ τὸ θηρίον, οὗτοι μισήσουσιν τὴν πόρνην, καὶ ἠρημωμένην ποιήσουσιν αὐτὴν καὶ γυμνήν, καὶ τὰς σάρκας αὐτῆς φάγονται, καὶ αὐτὴν κατακαύσουσιν [ἐν] πυρί:

text_en: For God has given into their hearts to do that which pleases him: that they give their kingdom to the beast, till the words of God be fulfilled.
text_la: Deus enim dedit in corda eorum ut faciant quod placitum est illi: ut dent regnum suum bestiæ donec consummentur verba Dei.
text_pt: Porque Deus tem posto em seus corações, que cumpram o seu intento, e tenham uma mesma idéia, e que dêem à besta o seu reino, até que se cumpram as palavras de Deus.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ θεὸς ἔδωκεν εἰς τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν ποιῆσαι τὴν γνώμην αὐτοῦ, καὶ ποιῆσαι μίαν γνώμην καὶ δοῦναι τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτῶν τῷ θηρίῳ, ἄχρι τελεσθήσονται οἱ λόγοι τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And the woman which you saw is the great city which has kingdom over the kings of the earth.
text_la: Et mulier, quam vidisti, est civitas magna, quæ habet regnum super reges terræ.
text_pt: E a mulher que viste é a grande cidade que reina sobre os reis da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἣν εἶδες ἔστιν ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη ἡ ἔχουσα βασιλείαν ἐπὶ τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς.

text_en: And after these things, I saw another angel come down from heaven , having great power: and the earth was enlightened with his glory .
text_la: Et post hæc vidi alium angelum descendentem de cælo, habentem potestatem magnam : et terra illuminata est a gloria ejus.
text_pt: E depois destas coisas vi descer do céu outro anjo, que tinha grande poder, e a terra foi iluminada com a sua glória.
text_el: Μετὰ ταῦτα εἶδον ἄλλον ἄγγελον καταβαίνοντα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἔχοντα ἐξουσίαν μεγάλην, καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐφωτίσθη ἐκ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he cried out with a strong voice, saying: Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen: and has become the habitation of devils and the hold of every unclean spirit and the hold of every unclean and hateful bird:
text_la: Et exclamavit in fortitudine, dicens : Cecidit, cecidit Babylon magna : et facta est habitatio dæmoniorum, et custodia omnis spiritus immundi, et custodia omnis volucris immundæ, et odibilis:
text_pt: E clamou fortemente com grande voz, dizendo: Caiu, caiu a grande Babilônia, e se tornou morada de demônios, e coito de todo espírito imundo, e coito de toda ave imunda e odiável.
text_el: καὶ ἔκραξεν ἐν ἰσχυρᾷ φωνῇ λέγων: ἔπεσεν, ἔπεσεν Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη, καὶ ἐγένετο κατοικητήριον δαιμονίων καὶ φυλακὴ παντὸς πνεύματος ἀκαθάρτου καὶ φυλακὴ παντὸς ὀρνέου ἀκαθάρτου καὶ μεμισημένου,

text_en: Because all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication: and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her; And the merchants of the earth have been made rich by the power of her delicacies.
text_la: quia de vino iræ fornicationis ejus biberunt omnes gentes : et reges terræ cum illa fornicati sunt : et mercatores terræ de virtute deliciarum ejus divites facti sunt.
text_pt: Porque todas as nações beberam do vinho da ira da sua fornicação, e os reis da terra fornicaram com ela; e os mercadores da terra se enriqueceram com a abundância de suas delícias.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκ [τοῦ οἴνου] τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς πέπωκαν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς μετ' αὐτῆς ἐπόρνευσαν, καὶ οἱ ἔμποροι τῆς γῆς ἐκ τῆς δυνάμεως τοῦ στρήνους αὐτῆς ἐπλούτησαν.

text_en: And I heard another voice from heaven , saying: Go out from her, my people; that you be not partakers of her sins and that you receive not of her plagues.
text_la: Et audivi aliam vocem de cælo, dicentem : Exite de illa populus meus : ut ne participes sitis delictorum ejus, et de plagis ejus non accipiatis.
text_pt: E ouvi outra voz do céu, que dizia: Sai dela, povo meu, para que não sejas participante dos seus pecados, e para que não incorras nas suas pragas.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσα ἄλλην φωνὴν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ λέγουσαν, ἐξέλθατε, ὁ λαός μου, ἐξ αὐτῆς, ἵνα μὴ συγκοινωνήσητε ταῖς ἁμαρτίαις αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐκ τῶν πληγῶν αὐτῆς ἵνα μὴ λάβητε:

text_en: For her sins have reached unto heaven : and the Lord has remembered her iniquities .
text_la: Quoniam pervenerunt peccata ejus usque ad cælum, et recordatus est Dominus iniquitatum ejus.
text_pt: Porque já os seus pecados se acumularam até ao céu, e Deus se lembrou das iniqüidades dela.
text_el: ὅτι ἐκολλήθησαν αὐτῆς αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ἄχρι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, καὶ ἐμνημόνευσεν ὁ θεὸς τὰ ἀδικήματα αὐτῆς.

text_en: Render to her as she also has rendered to you: and double unto her double, according to her works. In the cup wherein she has mingled, mingle double unto her.
text_la: Reddite illi sicut et ipsa reddidit vobis : et duplicate duplicia secundum opera ejus : in poculo, quo miscuit, miscete illi duplum.
text_pt: Tornai-lhe a dar como ela vos tem dado, e retribuí-lhe em dobro conforme as suas obras; no cálice em que vos deu de beber, dai-lhe a ela em dobro.
text_el: ἀπόδοτε αὐτῇ ὡς καὶ αὐτὴ ἀπέδωκεν, καὶ διπλώσατε [τὰ] διπλᾶ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῆς: ἐν τῷ ποτηρίῳ ᾧ ἐκέρασεν κεράσατε αὐτῇ διπλοῦν:

text_en: As much as she has glorified herself and lived in delicacies, so much torment and sorrow give to her. Because she says in her heart: I sit a queen and am no widow : and sorrow I shall not see.
text_la: Quantum glorificavit se, et in deliciis fuit, tantum date illi tormentum et luctum : quia in corde suo dicit : Sedeo regina : et vidua non sum, et luctum non videbo.
text_pt: Quanto ela se glorificou, e em delícias esteve, foi-lhe outro tanto de tormento e pranto; porque diz em seu coração: Estou assentada como rainha, e não sou viúva, e não verei o pranto.
text_el: ὅσα ἐδόξασεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἐστρηνίασεν, τοσοῦτον δότε αὐτῇ βασανισμὸν καὶ πένθος. ὅτι ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτῆς λέγει ὅτι κάθημαι βασίλισσα, καὶ χήρα οὐκ εἰμί, καὶ πένθος οὐ μὴ ἴδω:

text_en: Therefore, shall her plagues come in one day, death and mourning and famine. And she shall be burnt with the fire: because God is strong, who shall judge her.
text_la: Ideo in una die venient plagæ ejus, mors, et luctus, et fames, et igne comburetur : quia fortis est Deus, qui judicabit illam.
text_pt: Portanto, num dia virão as suas pragas, a morte, e o pranto, e a fome; e será queimada no fogo; porque é forte o Senhor Deus que a julga.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ ἥξουσιν αἱ πληγαὶ αὐτῆς, θάνατος καὶ πένθος καὶ λιμός, καὶ ἐν πυρὶ κατακαυθήσεται: ὅτι ἰσχυρὸς [κύριος] ὁ θεὸς ὁ κρίνας αὐτήν.

text_en: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived in delicacies with her, shall weep and bewail themselves over her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning:
text_la: Et flebunt, et plangent se super illam reges terræ, qui cum illa fornicati sunt, et in deliciis vixerunt, cum viderint fumum incendii ejus:
text_pt: E os reis da terra, que fornicaram com ela, e viveram em delícias, a chorarão, e sobre ela prantearão, quando virem a fumaça do seu incêndio;
text_el: Καὶ κλαύσουσιν καὶ κόψονται ἐπ' αὐτὴν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς οἱ μετ' αὐτῆς πορνεύσαντες καὶ στρηνιάσαντες, ὅταν βλέπωσιν τὸν καπνὸν τῆς πυρώσεως αὐτῆς,

text_en: Standing afar off for fear of her torments, saying: Alas! Alas! That great city, Babylon , that mighty city: for in one hour is your judgment come.
text_la: longe stantes propter timorem tormentorum ejus, dicentes : Væ, væ civitas illa magna Babylon, civitas illa fortis : quoniam una hora venit judicium tuum.
text_pt: Estando de longe pelo temor do seu tormento, dizendo: Ai! ai daquela grande cidade de Babilônia, aquela forte cidade! pois em uma hora veio o seu juízo.
text_el: ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἑστηκότες διὰ τὸν φόβον τοῦ βασανισμοῦ αὐτῆς, λέγοντες, οὐαὶ οὐαί, ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη, Βαβυλὼν ἡ πόλις ἡ ἰσχυρά, ὅτι μιᾷ ὥρᾳ ἦλθεν ἡ κρίσις σου.

text_en: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her: for no man shall buy their merchandise any more.
text_la: Et negotiatores terræ flebunt, et lugebunt super illam : quoniam merces eorum nemo emet amplius:
text_pt: E sobre ela choram e lamentam os mercadores da terra; porque ninguém mais compra as suas mercadorias:
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἔμποροι τῆς γῆς κλαίουσιν καὶ πενθοῦσιν ἐπ' αὐτήν, ὅτι τὸν γόμον αὐτῶν οὐδεὶς ἀγοράζει οὐκέτι,

text_en: Merchandise of gold and silver and precious stones : and of pearls and fine linen and purple and silk and scarlet: and all thyine wood: and all manner of vessels of ivory: and all manner of vessels of precious stone and of brass and of iron and of marble:
text_la: merces auri, et argenti, et lapidis pretiosi, et margaritæ, et byssi, et purpuræ, et serici, et cocci (et omne lignum thyinum, et omnia vasa eboris, et omnia vasa de lapide pretioso, et æramento, et ferro, et marmore,
text_pt: Mercadorias de ouro, e de prata, e de pedras preciosas, e de pérolas, e de linho fino, e de púrpura, e de seda, e de escarlata; e toda a madeira odorífera, e todo o vaso de marfim, e todo o vaso de madeira preciosíssima, de bronze e de ferro, e de mármore;
text_el: γόμον χρυσοῦ καὶ ἀργύρου καὶ λίθου τιμίου καὶ μαργαριτῶν καὶ βυσσίνου καὶ πορφύρας καὶ σιρικοῦ καὶ κοκκίνου, καὶ πᾶν ξύλον θύϊνον καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος ἐλεφάντινον καὶ πᾶν σκεῦος ἐκ ξύλου τιμιωτάτου καὶ χαλκοῦ καὶ σιδήρου καὶ μαρμάρου,

text_en: And cinnamon and odours and ointment and frankincense and wine and oil and fine flour and wheat and beasts and sheep and horses and chariots: and slaves and souls of men .
text_la: et cinnamomum) et odoramentorum, et unguenti, et thuris, et vini, et olei, et similæ, et tritici, et jumentorum, et ovium, et equorum, et rhedarum, et mancipiorum, et animarum hominum.
text_pt: E canela, e perfume, e mirra, e incenso, e vinho, e azeite, e flor de farinha, e trigo, e gado, e ovelhas; e cavalos, e carros, e corpos e almas de homens.
text_el: καὶ κιννάμωμον καὶ ἄμωμον καὶ θυμιάματα καὶ μύρον καὶ λίβανον καὶ οἶνον καὶ ἔλαιον καὶ σεμίδαλιν καὶ σῖτον καὶ κτήνη καὶ πρόβατα, καὶ ἵππων καὶ ῥεδῶν καὶ σωμάτων, καὶ ψυχὰς ἀνθρώπων.

text_en: And the fruits of the desire of your soul are departed from you: and all fat and goodly things are perished from you. And they shall find them no more at all.
text_la: Et poma desiderii animæ tuæ discesserunt a te, et omnia pinguia et præclara perierunt a te, et amplius illa jam non invenient.
text_pt: E o fruto do desejo da tua alma foi-se de ti; e todas as coisas gostosas e excelentes se foram de ti, e não mais as acharás.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ὀπώρα σου τῆς ἐπιθυμίας τῆς ψυχῆς ἀπῆλθεν ἀπὸ σοῦ, καὶ πάντα τὰ λιπαρὰ καὶ τὰ λαμπρὰ ἀπώλετο ἀπὸ σοῦ, καὶ οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ αὐτὰ εὑρήσουσιν.

text_en: The merchants of these things, who were made rich, shall stand afar off from her, for fear of her torments, weeping and mourning,
text_la: Mercatores horum, qui divites facti sunt, ab ea longe stabunt propter timorem tormentorum ejus, flentes, ac lugentes,
text_pt: Os mercadores destas coisas, que dela se enriqueceram, estarão de longe, pelo temor do seu tormento, chorando e lamentando,
text_el: οἱ ἔμποροι τούτων, οἱ πλουτήσαντες ἀπ' αὐτῆς, ἀπὸ μακρόθεν στήσονται διὰ τὸν φόβον τοῦ βασανισμοῦ αὐτῆς, κλαίοντες καὶ πενθοῦντες,

text_en: and saying: Alas! Alas! That great city, which was clothed with fine linen and purple and scarlet and was gilt with gold and precious stones and pearls.
text_la: et dicentes : Væ, væ civitas illa magna, quæ amicta erat bysso, et purpura, et cocco, et deaurata erat auro, et lapide pretioso, et margaritis:
text_pt: E dizendo: Ai, ai daquela grande cidade! que estava vestida de linho fino, de púrpura, de escarlata; e adornada com ouro e pedras preciosas e pérolas! porque numa hora foram assoladas tantas riquezas.
text_el: λέγοντες: οὐαὶ οὐαί, ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη, ἡ περιβεβλημένη βύσσινον καὶ πορφυροῦν καὶ κόκκινον, καὶ κεχρυσωμένη ἐν χρυσίῳ καὶ λίθῳ τιμίῳ καὶ μαργαρίτῃ,

text_en: For in one hour are so great riches come to nought. And every shipmaster and all that sail into the lake, and mariners, and as many as work in the sea, stood afar off,
text_la: quoniam una hora destitutæ sunt tantæ divitiæ, et omnis gubernator, et omnis qui in lacum navigat, et nautæ, et qui in mari operantur, longe steterunt,
text_pt: E todo piloto, e todo o que navega em naus, e todo marinheiro, e todos os que negociam no mar se puseram de longe;
text_el: ὅτι μιᾷ ὥρᾳ ἠρημώθη ὁ τοσοῦτος πλοῦτος. καὶ πᾶς κυβερνήτης καὶ πᾶς ὁ ἐπὶ τόπον πλέων καὶ ναῦται καὶ ὅσοι τὴν θάλασσαν ἐργάζονται ἀπὸ μακρόθεν ἔστησαν

text_en: and cried, seeing the place of her burning, saying: What city is like to this great city?
text_la: et clamaverunt videntes locum incendii ejus, dicentes : Quæ similis civitati huic magnæ?
text_pt: E, vendo a fumaça do seu incêndio, clamaram, dizendo: Que cidade é semelhante a esta grande cidade?
text_el: καὶ ἔκραξαν βλέποντες τὸν καπνὸν τῆς πυρώσεως αὐτῆς λέγοντες, τίς ὁμοία τῇ πόλει τῇ μεγάλῃ;

text_en: And they cast dust upon their heads and cried, weeping and mourning, saying: Alas! Alas! That great city, wherein all were made rich, that had ships at sea, by reason of her prices. For, in one hour she is made desolate.
text_la: et miserunt pulverem super capita sua, et clamaverunt flentes, et lugentes, dicentes : Væ, væ civitas illa magna, in qua divites facti sunt omnes, qui habebant naves in mari de pretiis ejus : quoniam una hora desolata est.
text_pt: E lançaram pó sobre as suas cabeças, e clamaram, chorando, e lamentando, e dizendo: Ai, ai daquela grande cidade! na qual todos os que tinham naus no mar se enriqueceram em razão da sua opulência; porque numa hora foi assolada.
text_el: καὶ ἔβαλον χοῦν ἐπὶ τὰς κεφαλὰς αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔκραξαν κλαίοντες καὶ πενθοῦντες, λέγοντες: οὐαὶ οὐαί, ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη, ἐν ᾗ ἐπλούτησαν πάντες οἱ ἔχοντες τὰ πλοῖα ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ἐκ τῆς τιμιότητος αὐτῆς, ὅτι μιᾷ ὥρᾳ ἠρημώθη.

text_en: Rejoice over her, you heaven and you holy apostles and prophets . For God has judged your judgment on her.
text_la: Exsulta super eam cælum, et sancti apostoli, et prophetæ : quoniam judicavit Deus judicium vestrum de illa.
text_pt: Alegra-te sobre ela, ó céu, e vós, santos apóstolos e profetas; porque já Deus julgou a vossa causa quanto a ela.
text_el: εὐφραίνου ἐπ' αὐτῇ, οὐρανέ, καὶ οἱ ἅγιοι καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι καὶ οἱ προφῆται, ὅτι ἔκρινεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ κρίμα ὑμῶν ἐξ αὐτῆς.

text_en: And a mighty angel took up a stone, as it were a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying: With such violence as this, shall Babylon , that great city, be thrown down and shall be found no more at all.
text_la: Et sustulit unus angelus fortis lapidem quasi molarem magnum, et misit in mare, dicens : Hoc impetu mittetur Babylon civitas illa magna, et ultra jam non invenietur.
text_pt: E um forte anjo levantou uma pedra como uma grande mó, e lançou-a no mar, dizendo: Com igual ímpeto será lançada babilônia, aquela grande cidade, e não será jamais achada.
text_el: καὶ ἦρεν εἷς ἄγγελος ἰσχυρὸς λίθον ὡς μύλινον μέγαν καὶ ἔβαλεν εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν λέγων, οὕτως ὁρμήματι βληθήσεται Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη πόλις, καὶ οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῇ ἔτι.

text_en: And the voice of harpers and of musicians and of them that play on the pipe and on the trumpet shall no more be heard at all in you: and no craftsman of any art whatsoever shall be found any more at all in you: and the sound of the mill shall be heard no more at all in you:
text_la: Et vox citharœdorum, et musicorum, et tibia canentium, et tuba non audietur in te amplius : et omnis artifex omnis artis non invenietur in te amplius : et vox molæ non audietur in te amplius:
text_pt: E em ti não se ouvirá mais a voz de harpistas, e de músicos, e de flautistas, e de trombeteiros, e nenhum artífice de arte alguma se achará mais em ti; e ruído de mó em ti não se ouvirá mais;
text_el: καὶ φωνὴ κιθαρῳδῶν καὶ μουσικῶν καὶ αὐλητῶν καὶ σαλπιστῶν οὐ μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι, καὶ πᾶς τεχνίτης [πάσης τέχνης] οὐ μὴ εὑρεθῇ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι, καὶ φωνὴ μύλου οὐ μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι,

text_en: And the light of the lamp shall shine no more at all in you: and the voice of the bridegroom and the bride shall be heard no more at all in you. For your merchants were the great men of the earth: for all nations have been deceived by your enchantments.
text_la: et lux lucernæ non lucebit in te amplius : et vox sponsi et sponsæ non audietur adhuc in te : quia mercatores tui erant principes terræ, quia in veneficiis tuis erraverunt omnes gentes.
text_pt: E luz de candeia não mais luzirá em ti, e voz de esposo e de esposa não mais em ti se ouvirá; porque os teus mercadores eram os grandes da terra; porque todas as nações foram enganadas pelas tuas feitiçarias.
text_el: καὶ φῶς λύχνου οὐ μὴ φάνῃ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι, καὶ φωνὴ νυμφίου καὶ νύμφης οὐ μὴ ἀκουσθῇ ἐν σοὶ ἔτι: ὅτι [οἱ] ἔμποροί σου ἦσαν οἱ μεγιστᾶνες τῆς γῆς, ὅτι ἐν τῇ φαρμακείᾳ σου ἐπλανήθησαν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη,

text_en: And in her was found the blood of prophets and of saints and of all that were slain upon the earth.
text_la: Et in ea sanguis prophetarum et sanctorum inventus est: et omnium qui interfecti sunt in terra.
text_pt: E nela se achou o sangue dos profetas, e dos santos, e de todos os que foram mortos na terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐν αὐτῇ αἷμα προφητῶν καὶ ἁγίων εὑρέθη καὶ πάντων τῶν ἐσφαγμένων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

text_en: After these things, I heard as it were the voice of much people in heaven , saying: Alleluia . Salvation and glory and power is to our God .
text_la: Post hæc audivi quasi vocem turbarum multarum in cælo dicentium : Alleluja : salus, et gloria, et virtus Deo nostro est:
text_pt: E, depois destas coisas ouvi no céu uma grande voz de uma grande multidão, que dizia: Aleluia! A salvação, e a glória, e a honra, e o poder pertencem ao Senhor nosso Deus;
text_el: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἤκουσα ὡς φωνὴν μεγάλην ὄχλου πολλοῦ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ λεγόντων, ἁλληλουϊά: ἡ σωτηρία καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ ἡ δύναμις τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν,

text_en: For true and just are his judgments, who has judged the great harlot which corrupted the earth with her fornication and has revenged the blood of his servants, at her hands.
text_la: quia vera et justa judicia sunt ejus, qui judicavit de meretrice magna, quæ corrupit terram in prostitutione sua, et vindicavit sanguinem servorum suorum de manibus ejus.
text_pt: Porque verdadeiros e justos são os seus juízos, pois julgou a grande prostituta, que havia corrompido a terra com a sua fornicação, e das mãos dela vingou o sangue dos seus servos.
text_el: ὅτι ἀληθιναὶ καὶ δίκαιαι αἱ κρίσεις αὐτοῦ: ὅτι ἔκρινεν τὴν πόρνην τὴν μεγάλην ἥτις ἔφθειρεν τὴν γῆν ἐν τῇ πορνείᾳ αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐξεδίκησεν τὸ αἷμα τῶν δούλων αὐτοῦ ἐκ χειρὸς αὐτῆς.

text_en: And again they said: Alleluia . And her smoke ascends for ever and ever.
text_la: Et iterum dixerunt : Alleluja. Et fumus ejus ascendit in sæcula sæculorum.
text_pt: E outra vez disseram: Aleluia! E a fumaça dela sobe para todo o sempre.
text_el: καὶ δεύτερον εἴρηκαν, ἁλληλουϊά: καὶ ὁ καπνὸς αὐτῆς ἀναβαίνει εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.

text_en: And the four and twenty ancients and the four living creatures fell down and adored God that sits upon the throne, saying: Amen . Alleluia .
text_la: Et ceciderunt seniores viginti quatuor, et quatuor animalia, et adoraverunt Deum sedentem super thronum, dicentes : Amen : alleluja.
text_pt: E os vinte e quatro anciãos, e os quatro animais, prostraram-se e adoraram a Deus, que estava assentado no trono, dizendo: Amém. Aleluia!
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσαν οἱ πρεσβύτεροι οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα, καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ θεῷ τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ, λέγοντες, ἀμήν, ἁλληλουϊά.

text_en: And a voice came out from the throne, saying: Give praise to our God , all you his servants: and you that fear him, little and great.
text_la: Et vox de throno exivit, dicens : Laudem dicite Deo nostro omnes servi ejus : et qui timetis eum pusilli et magni.
text_pt: E saiu uma voz do trono, que dizia: Louvai o nosso Deus, vós, todos os seus servos, e vós que o temeis, assim pequenos como grandes.
text_el: καὶ φωνὴ ἀπὸ τοῦ θρόνου ἐξῆλθεν λέγουσα, αἰνεῖτε τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν, πάντες οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ, οἱ φοβούμενοι αὐτόν, οἱ μικροὶ καὶ οἱ μεγάλοι.

text_en: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of great thunders, saying: Alleluia : for the Lord our God , the Almighty, has reigned.
text_la: Et audivi quasi vocem turbæ magnæ, et sicut vocem aquarum multarum, et sicut vocem tonitruorum magnorum, dicentium : Alleluja : quoniam regnavit Dominus Deus noster omnipotens.
text_pt: E ouvi como que a voz de uma grande multidão, e como que a voz de muitas águas, e como que a voz de grandes trovões, que dizia: Aleluia! pois já o Senhor Deus Todo-Poderoso reina.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσα ὡς φωνὴν ὄχλου πολλοῦ καὶ ὡς φωνὴν ὑδάτων πολλῶν καὶ ὡς φωνὴν βροντῶν ἰσχυρῶν λεγόντων, ἁλληλουϊά, ὅτι ἐβασίλευσεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὁ παντοκράτωρ.

text_en: Let us be glad and rejoice and give glory to him. For the marriage of the Lamb has come: and his wife has prepared herself.
text_la: Gaudeamus, et exsultemus : et demus gloriam ei : quia venerunt nuptiæ Agni, et uxor ejus præparavit se.
text_pt: Regozijemo-nos, e alegremo-nos, e demos-lhe glória; porque vindas são as bodas do Cordeiro, e já a sua esposa se aprontou.
text_el: χαίρωμεν καὶ ἀγαλλιῶμεν, καὶ δώσομεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτῷ, ὅτι ἦλθεν ὁ γάμος τοῦ ἀρνίου, καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ ἡτοίμασεν ἑαυτήν:

text_en: And it is granted to her that she should clothe herself with fine linen, glittering and white. For the fine linen are the justifications of saints .
text_la: Et datum est illi ut cooperiat se byssino splendenti et candido. Byssinum enim justificationes sunt sanctorum.
text_pt: E foi-lhe dado que se vestisse de linho fino, puro e resplandecente; porque o linho fino são as justiças dos santos.
text_el: καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῇ ἵνα περιβάληται βύσσινον λαμπρὸν καθαρόν, τὸ γὰρ βύσσινον τὰ δικαιώματα τῶν ἁγίων ἐστίν.

text_en: And he said to me: Write: Blessed are they that are called to the marriage supper of the Lamb . And he says to me: These words of God are true .
text_la: Et dixit mihi : Scribe : Beati qui ad cœnam nuptiarum Agni vocati sunt; et dixit mihi : Hæc verba Dei vera sunt.
text_pt: E disse-me: Escreve: Bemaventurados aqueles que são chamados à ceia das bodas do Cordeiro. E disse-me: Estas são as verdadeiras palavras de Deus.
text_el: καὶ λέγει μοι, γράψον: μακάριοι οἱ εἰς τὸ δεῖπνον τοῦ γάμου τοῦ ἀρνίου κεκλημένοι. καὶ λέγει μοι, οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι ἀληθινοὶ τοῦ θεοῦ εἰσιν.

text_en: And I fell down before his feet, to adore him. And he says to me: See thou do it not. I am your fellow servant and of your brethren who have the testimony of Jesus . Adore God . For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy .
text_la: Et cecidi ante pedes ejus, ut adorarem eum. Et dicit mihi : Vide ne feceris : conservus tuus sum, et fratrum tuorum habentium testimonium Jesu. Deum adora. Testimonium enim Jesu est spiritus prophetiæ.
text_pt: E eu lancei-me a seus pés para o adorar; mas ele disse-me: Olha não faças tal; sou teu conservo, e de teus irmãos, que têm o testemunho de Jesus. Adora a Deus; porque o testemunho de Jesus é o espírito de profecia.
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσα ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ προσκυνῆσαι αὐτῷ. καὶ λέγει μοι, ὅρα μή: σύνδουλός σού εἰμι καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου τῶν ἐχόντων τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ: τῷ θεῷ προσκύνησον. ἡ γὰρ μαρτυρία Ἰησοῦ ἐστιν τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς προφητείας.

text_en: And I saw heaven opened: and behold a white horse. And he that sat upon him was called faithful and true : and with justice does he judge and fight.
text_la: Et vidi cælum apertum, et ecce equus albus, et qui sedebat super eum, vocabatur Fidelis, et Verax, et cum justitia judicat et pugnat.
text_pt: E vi o céu aberto, e eis um cavalo branco; e o que estava assentado sobre ele chama-se Fiel e Verdadeiro; e julga e peleja com justiça.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον τὸν οὐρανὸν ἠνεῳγμένον, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἵππος λευκός, καὶ ὁ καθήμενος ἐπ' αὐτὸν πιστὸς [καλούμενος] καὶ ἀληθινός, καὶ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ κρίνει καὶ πολεμεῖ.

text_en: And his eyes were as a flame of fire: and on his head were many diadems. And he had a name written, which no man knows but himself.
text_la: Oculi autem ejus sicut flamma ignis, et in capite ejus diademata multa, habens nomen scriptum, quod nemo novit nisi ipse.
text_pt: E os seus olhos eram como chama de fogo; e sobre a sua cabeça havia muitos diademas; e tinha um nome escrito, que ninguém sabia senão ele mesmo.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ φλὸξ πυρός, καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ διαδήματα πολλά, ἔχων ὄνομα γεγραμμένον ὃ οὐδεὶς οἶδεν εἰ μὴ αὐτός,

text_en: And he was clothed with a garment sprinkled with blood. And his name is called: THE WORD OF GOD .
text_la: Et vestitus erat veste aspersa sanguine : et vocatur nomen ejus : Verbum Dei.
text_pt: E estava vestido de veste tingida em sangue; e o nome pelo qual se chama é A Palavra de Deus.
text_el: καὶ περιβεβλημένος ἱμάτιον ῤεραντισμένον αἵματι, καὶ κέκληται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ.

text_en: And the armies that are in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
text_la: Et exercitus qui sunt in cælo, sequebantur eum in equis albis, vestiti byssino albo et mundo.
text_pt: E seguiam-no os exércitos no céu em cavalos brancos, e vestidos de linho fino, branco e puro.
text_el: καὶ τὰ στρατεύματα τὰ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ ἐφ' ἵπποις λευκοῖς, ἐνδεδυμένοι βύσσινον λευκὸν καθαρόν.

text_en: And out of his mouth proceeds a sharp two-edged sword, that with it he may strike the nations. And he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treads the winepress of the fierceness of the wrath of God the Almighty .
text_la: Et de ore ejus procedit gladius ex utraque parte acutus, ut in ipso percutiat gentes. Et ipse reget eas in virga ferrea : et ipse calcat torcular vini furoris iræ Dei omnipotentis.
text_pt: E da sua boca saía uma aguda espada, para ferir com ela as nações; e ele as regerá com vara de ferro; e ele mesmo é o que pisa o lagar do vinho do furor e da ira do Deus Todo-Poderoso.
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ ἐκπορεύεται ῥομφαία ὀξεῖα, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῇ πατάξῃ τὰ ἔθνη, καὶ αὐτὸς ποιμανεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ: καὶ αὐτὸς πατεῖ τὴν ληνὸν τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς ὀργῆς τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ παντοκράτορος.

text_en: And he has on his garment and on his thigh written: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
text_la: Et habet in vestimento et in femore suo scriptum : Rex regum et Dominus dominantium.
text_pt: E no manto e na sua coxa tem escrito este nome: Rei dos reis, e Senhor dos senhores.
text_el: καὶ ἔχει ἐπὶ τὸ ἱμάτιον καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν μηρὸν αὐτοῦ ὄνομα γεγραμμένον: ΒΑΣΙΛΕΥ{*J} ΒΑΣΙΛΕΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΚΥΡΙΟ{*J} ΚΥΡΙΩΝ.

text_en: And I saw an angel standing in the sun: and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that flew through the midst of heaven : Come, gather yourselves together to the great supper of God :
text_la: Et vidi unum angelum stantem in sole, et clamavit voce magna, dicens omnibus avibus, quæ volabant per medium cæli : Venite, et congregamini ad cœnam magnam Dei:
text_pt: E vi um anjo que estava no sol, e clamou com grande voz, dizendo a todas as aves que voavam pelo meio do céu: Vinde, e ajuntai-vos à ceia do grande Deus;
text_el: καὶ εἶδον ἕνα ἄγγελον ἑστῶτα ἐν τῷ ἡλίῳ, καὶ ἔκραξεν ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ λέγων πᾶσιν τοῖς ὀρνέοις τοῖς πετομένοις ἐν μεσουρανήματι, δεῦτε συνάχθητε εἰς τὸ δεῖπνον τὸ μέγα τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: That you may eat the flesh of kings and the flesh of tribunes and the flesh of mighty men and the flesh of horses and of them that sit on them: and the flesh of all freemen and bondmen and of little and of great.
text_la: ut manducetis carnes regum, et carnes tribunorum, et carnes fortium, et carnes equorum, et sedentium in ipsis, et carnes omnium liberorum, et servorum, et pusillorum et magnorum.
text_pt: Para que comais a carne dos reis, e a carne dos tribunos, e a carne dos fortes, e a carne dos cavalos e dos que sobre eles se assentam; e a carne de todos os homens, livres e servos, pequenos e grandes.
text_el: ἵνα φάγητε σάρκας βασιλέων καὶ σάρκας χιλιάρχων καὶ σάρκας ἰσχυρῶν καὶ σάρκας ἵππων καὶ τῶν καθημένων ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ σάρκας πάντων ἐλευθέρων τε καὶ δούλων καὶ μικρῶν καὶ μεγάλων.

text_en: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies, gathered together to make war with him that sat upon the horse and with his army.
text_la: Et vidi bestiam, et reges terræ, et exercitus eorum congregatos ad faciendum prælium cum illo, qui sedebat in equo, et cum exercitu ejus.
text_pt: E vi a besta, e os reis da terra, e os seus exércitos reunidos, para fazerem guerra àquele que estava assentado sobre o cavalo, e ao seu exército.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον τὸ θηρίον καὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰ στρατεύματα αὐτῶν συνηγμένα ποιῆσαι τὸν πόλεμον μετὰ τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ ἵππου καὶ μετὰ τοῦ στρατεύματος αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who wrought signs before him, wherewith he seduced them who received the character of the beast and who adored his image. These two were cast alive into the pool of fire burning with brimstone .
text_la: Et apprehensa est bestia, et cum ea pseudopropheta : qui fecit signa coram ipso, quibus seduxit eos, qui acceperunt caracterem bestiæ, et qui adoraverunt imaginem ejus. Vivi missi sunt hi duo in stagnum ignis ardentis sulphure:
text_pt: E a besta foi presa, e com ela o falso profeta, que diante dela fizera os sinais, com que enganou os que receberam o sinal da besta, e adoraram a sua imagem. Estes dois foram lançados vivos no lago de fogo que arde com enxofre.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιάσθη τὸ θηρίον καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ὁ ψευδοπροφήτης ὁ ποιήσας τὰ σημεῖα ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, ἐν οἷς ἐπλάνησεν τοὺς λαβόντας τὸ χάραγμα τοῦ θηρίου καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας τῇ εἰκόνι αὐτοῦ: ζῶντες ἐβλήθησαν οἱ δύο εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρὸς τῆς καιομένης ἐν θείῳ.

text_en: And the rest were slain by the sword of him that sits upon the horse, which proceeds out of his mouth: and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
text_la: et ceteri occisi sunt in gladio sedentis super equum, qui procedit de ore ipsius : et omnes aves saturatæ sunt carnibus eorum.
text_pt: E os demais foram mortos com a espada que saía da boca do que estava assentado sobre o cavalo, e todas as aves se fartaram das suas carnes.
text_el: καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἀπεκτάνθησαν ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ ἵππου τῇ ἐξελθούσῃ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ, καὶ πάντα τὰ ὄρνεα ἐχορτάσθησαν ἐκ τῶν σαρκῶν αὐτῶν.

text_en: And I saw an angel coming down from heaven , having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
text_la: Et vidi angelum descendentem de cælo, habentem clavem abyssi, et catenam magnam in manu sua.
text_pt: E vi descer do céu um anjo, que tinha a chave do abismo, e uma grande cadeia na sua mão.
text_el: Καὶ εἶδον ἄγγελον καταβαίνοντα ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, ἔχοντα τὴν κλεῖν τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ ἅλυσιν μεγάλην ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ.

text_en: And he laid hold on the dragon, the old serpent, which is the devil and Satan , and bound him for a thousand years .
text_la: Et apprehendit draconem, serpentem antiquum, qui est diabolus, et Satanas, et ligavit eum per annos mille:
text_pt: Ele prendeu o dragão, a antiga serpente, que é o Diabo e Satanás, e amarrou-o por mil anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐκράτησεν τὸν δράκοντα, ὁ ὄφις ὁ ἀρχαῖος, ὅς ἐστιν Διάβολος καὶ ὁ Σατανᾶς, καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτὸν χίλια ἔτη,

text_en: And he cast him into the bottomless pit and shut him up and set a seal upon him, that he should no more seduce the nations till the thousand years be finished. And after that, he must be loosed a little time.
text_la: et misit eum in abyssum, et clausit, et signavit super illum ut non seducat amplius gentes, donec consummentur mille anni : et post hæc oportet illum solvi modico tempore.
text_pt: E lançou-o no abismo, e ali o encerrou, e pôs selo sobre ele, para que não mais engane as nações, até que os mil anos se acabem. E depois importa que seja solto por um pouco de tempo.
text_el: καὶ ἔβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν ἄβυσσον καὶ ἔκλεισεν καὶ ἐσφράγισεν ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ ἵνα μὴ πλανήσῃ ἔτι τὰ ἔθνη ἄχρι τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη: μετὰ ταῦτα δεῖ λυθῆναι αὐτὸν μικρὸν χρόνον.

text_en: And I saw seats. And they sat upon them: and judgment was given unto them. And the souls of them that were beheaded for the testimony of Jesus and for the word of God and who had not adored the beast nor his image nor received his character on their foreheads or in their hands. And they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years .
text_la: Et vidi sedes, et sederunt super eas, et judicium datum est illis : et animas decollatorum propter testimonium Jesu, et propter verbum Dei, et qui non adoraverunt bestiam, neque imaginem ejus, nec acceperunt caracterem ejus in frontibus, aut in manibus suis, et vixerunt, et regnaverunt cum Christo mille annis.
text_pt: E vi tronos; e assentaram-se sobre eles, e foi-lhes dado o poder de julgar; e vi as almas daqueles que foram degolados pelo testemunho de Jesus, e pela palavra de Deus, e que não adoraram a besta, nem a sua imagem, e não receberam o sinal em suas testas nem em suas mãos; e viveram, e reinaram com Cristo durante mil anos.
text_el: Καὶ εἶδον θρόνους, καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐπ' αὐτούς, καὶ κρίμα ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς, καὶ τὰς ψυχὰς τῶν πεπελεκισμένων διὰ τὴν μαρτυρίαν Ἰησοῦ καὶ διὰ τὸν λόγον τοῦ θεοῦ, καὶ οἵτινες οὐ προσεκύνησαν τὸ θηρίον οὐδὲ τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔλαβον τὸ χάραγμα ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτῶν: καὶ ἔζησαν καὶ ἐβασίλευσαν μετὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ χίλια ἔτη.

text_en: The rest of the dead lived not, till the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
text_la: Ceteri mortuorum non vixerunt, donec consummentur mille anni. Hæc est resurrectio prima.
text_pt: Mas os outros mortos não reviveram, até que os mil anos se acabaram. Esta é a primeira ressurreição.
text_el: οἱ λοιποὶ τῶν νεκρῶν οὐκ ἔζησαν ἄχρι τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη. αὕτη ἡ ἀνάστασις ἡ πρώτη.

text_en: Blessed and holy is he that has part in the first resurrection. In these the second death has no power. But they shall be priests of God and of Christ : and shall reign with him a thousand years .
text_la: Beatus, et sanctus, qui habet partem in resurrectione prima : in his secunda mors non habet potestatem : sed erunt sacerdotes Dei et Christi, et regnabunt cum illo mille annis.
text_pt: Bem-aventurado e santo aquele que tem parte na primeira ressurreição; sobre estes não tem poder a segunda morte; mas serão sacerdotes de Deus e de Cristo, e reinarão com ele mil anos.
text_el: μακάριος καὶ ἅγιος ὁ ἔχων μέρος ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει τῇ πρώτῃ: ἐπὶ τούτων ὁ δεύτερος θάνατος οὐκ ἔχει ἐξουσίαν, ἀλλ' ἔσονται ἱερεῖς τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν μετ' αὐτοῦ τὰ χίλια ἔτη.

text_en: And when the thousand years shall be finished, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison and shall go forth and seduce the nations which are over the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog : and shall gather them together to battle, the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
text_la: Et cum consummati fuerint mille anni, solvetur Satanas de carcere suo, et exibit, et seducet gentes, quæ sunt super quatuor angulos terræ, Gog, et Magog, et congregabit eos in prælium, quorum numerus est sicut arena maris.
text_pt: E, acabando-se os mil anos, Satanás será solto da sua prisão,
text_el: Καὶ ὅταν τελεσθῇ τὰ χίλια ἔτη, λυθήσεται ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐκ τῆς φυλακῆς αὐτοῦ,

text_en: And they came upon the breadth of the earth and encompassed the camp of the saints and the beloved city.
text_la: Et ascenderunt super latitudinem terræ, et circuierunt castra sanctorum, et civitatem dilectam.
text_pt: E sairá a enganar as nações que estão sobre os quatro cantos da terra, Gogue e Magogue, cujo número é como a areia do mar, para as ajuntar em batalha.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελεύσεται πλανῆσαι τὰ ἔθνη τὰ ἐν ταῖς τέσσαρσιν γωνίαις τῆς γῆς, τὸν Γὼγ καὶ Μαγώγ, συναγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν πόλεμον, ὧν ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης.

text_en: And there came down fire from God out of heaven and devoured them: and the devil , who seduced them, was cast into the pool of fire and brimstone , where both the beast
text_la: Et descendit ignis a Deo de cælo, et devoravit eos : et diabolus, qui seducebat eos, missus est in stagnum ignis, et sulphuris, ubi et bestia
text_pt: E subiram sobre a largura da terra, e cercaram o arraial dos santos e a cidade amada; e de Deus desceu fogo, do céu, e os devorou.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὸ πλάτος τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκύκλευσαν τὴν παρεμβολὴν τῶν ἁγίων καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἠγαπημένην. καὶ κατέβη πῦρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ κατέφαγεν αὐτούς:

text_en: and the false prophet shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
text_la: et pseudopropheta cruciabuntur die ac nocte in sæcula sæculorum.
text_pt: E o diabo, que os enganava, foi lançado no lago de fogo e enxofre, onde estão a besta e o falso profeta; e de dia e de noite serão atormentados para todo o sempre.
text_el: καὶ ὁ διάβολος ὁ πλανῶν αὐτοὺς ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρὸς καὶ θείου, ὅπου καὶ τὸ θηρίον καὶ ὁ ψευδοπροφήτης, καὶ βασανισθήσονται ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.

text_en: And I saw a great white throne and one sitting upon it, from whose face the earth and heaven fled away: and there was no place found for them.
text_la: Et vidi thronum magnum candidum, et sedentem super eum, a cujus conspectu fugit terra, et cælum, et locus non est inventus eis.
text_pt: E vi um grande trono branco, e o que estava assentado sobre ele, de cuja presença fugiu a terra e o céu; e não se achou lugar para eles.
text_el: Καὶ εἶδον θρόνον μέγαν λευκὸν καὶ τὸν καθήμενον ἐπ' αὐτοῦ, οὗ ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου ἔφυγεν ἡ γῆ καὶ ὁ οὐρανός, καὶ τόπος οὐχ εὑρέθη αὐτοῖς.

text_en: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing in the presence of the throne. And the books were opened: and another book was opened, which was the book of life. And the dead were judged by those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
text_la: Et vidi mortuos, magnos et pusillos, stantes in conspectu throni, et libri aperti sunt : et alius liber apertus est, qui est vitæ : et judicati sunt mortui ex his, quæ scripta erant in libris, secundum opera ipsorum:
text_pt: E vi os mortos, grandes e pequenos, que estavam diante de Deus, e abriram-se os livros; e abriu-se outro livro, que é o da vida. E os mortos foram julgados pelas coisas que estavam escritas nos livros, segundo as suas obras.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον τοὺς νεκρούς, τοὺς μεγάλους καὶ τοὺς μικρούς, ἑστῶτας ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου, καὶ βιβλία ἠνοίχθησαν: καὶ ἄλλο βιβλίον ἠνοίχθη, ὅ ἐστιν τῆς ζωῆς: καὶ ἐκρίθησαν οἱ νεκροὶ ἐκ τῶν γεγραμμένων ἐν τοῖς βιβλίοις κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν.

text_en: And the sea gave up the dead that were in it: and death and hell gave up their dead that were in them. And they were judged, every one according to their works.
text_la: et dedit mare mortuos, qui in eo erant : et mors et infernus dederunt mortuos suos, qui in ipsis erant : et judicatum est de singulis secundum opera ipsorum.
text_pt: E deu o mar os mortos que nele havia; e a morte e o inferno deram os mortos que neles havia; e foram julgados cada um segundo as suas obras.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ἡ θάλασσα τοὺς νεκροὺς τοὺς ἐν αὐτῇ, καὶ ὁ θάνατος καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἔδωκαν τοὺς νεκροὺς τοὺς ἐν αὐτοῖς, καὶ ἐκρίθησαν ἕκαστος κατὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν.

text_en: And hell and death were cast into the pool of fire . This is the second death.
text_la: Et infernus et mors missi sunt in stagnum ignis. Hæc est mors secunda.
text_pt: E a morte e o inferno foram lançados no lago de fogo. Esta é a segunda morte.
text_el: καὶ ὁ θάνατος καὶ ὁ ᾅδης ἐβλήθησαν εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρός. οὗτος ὁ θάνατος ὁ δεύτερός ἐστιν, ἡ λίμνη τοῦ πυρός.

text_en: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the pool of fire .
text_la: Et qui non inventus est in libro vitæ scriptus, missus est in stagnum ignis.
text_pt: E aquele que não foi achado escrito no livro da vida foi lançado no lago de fogo.
text_el: καὶ εἴ τις οὐχ εὑρέθη ἐν τῇ βίβλῳ τῆς ζωῆς γεγραμμένος ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν λίμνην τοῦ πυρός.

text_en: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. For the first heaven and the first earth was gone: and the sea is now no more.
text_la: Et vidi cælum novum et terram novam. Primum enim cælum, et prima terra abiit, et mare jam non est.
text_pt: E vi um novo céu, e uma nova terra. Porque já o primeiro céu e a primeira terra passaram, e o mar já não existe.
text_el: Καὶ εἶδον οὐρανὸν καινὸν καὶ γῆν καινήν: ὁ γὰρ πρῶτος οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ πρώτη γῆ ἀπῆλθαν, καὶ ἡ θάλασσα οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι.

text_en: And I, John , saw the holy city , the new Jerusalem , coming down out of heaven from God , prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
text_la: Et ego Joannes vidi sanctam civitatem Jerusalem novam descendentem de cælo a Deo, paratam sicut sponsam ornatam viro suo.
text_pt: E eu, João, vi a santa cidade, a nova Jerusalém, que de Deus descia do céu, adereçada como uma esposa ataviada para o seu marido.
text_el: καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἁγίαν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καινὴν εἶδον καταβαίνουσαν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἡτοιμασμένην ὡς νύμφην κεκοσμημένην τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς.

text_en: And I heard a great voice from the throne, saying: Behold the tabernacle of God with men : and he will dwell with them. And they shall be his people: and God himself with them shall be their God .
text_la: Et audivi vocem magnam de throno dicentem : Ecce tabernaculum Dei cum hominibus, et habitabit cum eis. Et ipsi populus ejus erunt, et ipse Deus cum eis erit eorum Deus:
text_pt: E ouvi uma grande voz do céu, que dizia: Eis aqui o tabernáculo de Deus com os homens, pois com eles habitará, e eles serão o seu povo, e o mesmo Deus estará com eles, e será o seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσα φωνῆς μεγάλης ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου λεγούσης, ἰδοὺ ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ θεοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ σκηνώσει μετ' αὐτῶν, καὶ αὐτοὶ λαοὶ αὐτοῦ ἔσονται, καὶ αὐτὸς ὁ θεὸς μετ' αὐτῶν ἔσται,

text_en: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes: and death shall be no more. Nor mourning, nor crying, nor sorrow shall be any more, for the former things are passed away.
text_la: et absterget Deus omnem lacrimam ab oculis eorum : et mors ultra non erit, neque luctus, neque clamor, neque dolor erit ultra, quia prima abierunt.
text_pt: E Deus limpará de seus olhos toda a lágrima; e não haverá mais morte, nem pranto, nem clamor, nem dor; porque já as primeiras coisas são passadas.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαλείψει πᾶν δάκρυον ἐκ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ ὁ θάνατος οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι, οὔτε πένθος οὔτε κραυγὴ οὔτε πόνος οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι: τὰ πρῶτα ἀπῆλθαν.

text_en: And he that sat on the throne, said: Behold, I make all things new. And he said to me: Write. For these words are most faithful and true .
text_la: Et dixit qui sedebat in throno : Ecce nova facio omnia. Et dixit mihi : Scribe, quia hæc verba fidelissima sunt, et vera.
text_pt: E o que estava assentado sobre o trono disse: Eis que faço novas todas as coisas. E disse-me: Escreve; porque estas palavras são verdadeiras e fiéis.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ: ἰδοὺ καινὰ ποιῶ πάντα. καὶ λέγει: γράψον, ὅτι οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι πιστοὶ καὶ ἀληθινοί εἰσιν.

text_en: And he said to me: It is done. I am Alpha and Omega : the Beginning and the End. To him that thirsts, I will give of the fountain of the water of life, freely.
text_la: Et dixit mihi : Factum est : ego sum alpha et omega, initium et finis. Ego sitienti dabo de fonte aquæ vitæ, gratis.
text_pt: E disse-me mais: Está cumprido. Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o princípio e o fim. A quem quer que tiver sede, de graça lhe darei da fonte da água da vida.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι: γέγοναν. ἐγώ τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ, Ὦ ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ. τέλος ἐγὼ τῷ διψῶντι δώσω ἐκ τῆς πηγῆς τοῦ ὕδατος τῆς ζωῆς δωρεάν.

text_en: He that shall overcome shall possess these things. And I will be his God : and he shall be my son.
text_la: Qui vicerit, possidebit hæc : et ero illi Deus, et ille erit mihi filius.
text_pt: Quem vencer, herdará todas as coisas; e eu serei seu Deus, e ele será meu filho.
text_el: ὁ νικῶν κληρονομήσει ταῦτα, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ θεὸς καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι υἱός.

text_en: But the fearful and unbelieving and the abominable and murderers and whoremongers and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars , they shall have their portion in the pool burning with fire and brimstone , which is the second death.
text_la: Timidis autem, et incredulis, et execratis, et homicidis, et fornicatoribus, et veneficis, et idolatris, et omnibus mendacibus, pars illorum erit in stagno ardenti igne et sulphure : quod est mors secunda.
text_pt: Mas, quanto aos tímidos, e aos incrédulos, e aos abomináveis, e aos homicidas, e aos que se prostituem, e aos feiticeiros, e aos idólatras e a todos os mentirosos, a sua parte será no lago que arde com fogo e enxofre; o que é a segunda morte.
text_el: τοῖς δὲ δειλοῖς καὶ ἀπίστοις καὶ ἐβδελυγμένοις καὶ φονεῦσιν καὶ πόρνοις καὶ φαρμάκοις καὶ εἰδωλολάτραις καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ψευδέσιν τὸ μέρος αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ λίμνῃ τῇ καιομένῃ πυρὶ καὶ θείῳ, ὅ ἐστιν ὁ θάνατος ὁ δεύτερος.

text_en: And there came one of the seven angels , who had the vials full of the seven last plagues, and spoke with me, saying: Come and I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb .
text_la: Et venit unus de septem angelis habentibus phialas plenas septem plagis novissimis, et locutus est mecum, dicens : Veni, et ostendam tibi sponsam, uxorem Agni.
text_pt: E veio a mim um dos sete anjos que tinham as sete taças cheias das últimas sete pragas, e falou comigo, dizendo: Vem, mostrar-te-ei a esposa, a mulher do Cordeiro.
text_el: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἷς ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλων τῶν ἐχόντων τὰς ἑπτὰ φιάλας, τῶν γεμόντων τῶν ἑπτὰ πληγῶν τῶν ἐσχάτων, καὶ ἐλάλησεν μετ' ἐμοῦ λέγων, δεῦρο, δείξω σοι τὴν νύμφην τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ ἀρνίου.

text_en: And he took me up in spirit to a great and high mountain: and he showed me the holy city Jerusalem , coming down out of heaven from God ,
text_la: Et sustulit me in spiritu in montem magnum et altum, et ostendit mihi civitatem sanctam Jerusalem descendentem de cælo a Deo,
text_pt: E levou-me em espírito a um grande e alto monte, e mostrou-me a grande cidade, a santa Jerusalém, que de Deus descia do céu.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήνεγκέν με ἐν πνεύματι ἐπὶ ὄρος μέγα καὶ ὑψηλόν, καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἁγίαν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καταβαίνουσαν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ,

text_en: having the glory of God , and the light thereof was like to a precious stone , as to the jasper stone even as crystal.
text_la: habentem claritatem Dei : et lumen ejus simile lapidi pretioso tamquam lapidi jaspidis, sicut crystallum.
text_pt: E tinha a glória de Deus; e a sua luz era semelhante a uma pedra preciosíssima, como a pedra de jaspe, como o cristal resplandecente.
text_el: ἔχουσαν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ: ὁ φωστὴρ αὐτῆς ὅμοιος λίθῳ τιμιωτάτῳ, ὡς λίθῳ ἰάσπιδι κρυσταλλίζοντι:

text_en: And it had a wall great and high, having twelve gates, and in the gates twelve angels , and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel .
text_la: Et habebat murum magnum, et altum, habentem portas duodecim : et in portis angelos duodecim, et nomina inscripta, quæ sunt nomina duodecim tribuum filiorum Israël:
text_pt: E tinha um grande e alto muro com doze portas, e nas portas doze anjos, e nomes escritos sobre elas, que são os nomes das doze tribos dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: ἔχουσα τεῖχος μέγα καὶ ὑψηλόν, ἔχουσα πυλῶνας δώδεκα, καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς πυλῶσιν ἀγγέλους δώδεκα, καὶ ὀνόματα ἐπιγεγραμμένα ἅ ἐστιν τῶν δώδεκα φυλῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

text_en: On the east, three gates: and on the north, three gates: and on the south, three gates: and on the west, three gates.
text_la: ab oriente portæ tres, et ab aquilone portæ tres, et ab austro portæ tres, et ab occasu portæ tres.
text_pt: Do lado do levante tinha três portas, do lado do norte, três portas, do lado do sul, três portas, do lado do poente, três portas.
text_el: ἀπὸ ἀνατολῆς πυλῶνες τρεῖς, καὶ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ πυλῶνες τρεῖς, καὶ ἀπὸ νότου πυλῶνες τρεῖς, καὶ ἀπὸ δυσμῶν πυλῶνες τρεῖς.

text_en: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations: And in them, the twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb ,
text_la: Et murus civitatis habens fundamenta duodecim, et in ipsis duodecim nomina duodecim apostolorum Agni.
text_pt: E o muro da cidade tinha doze fundamentos, e neles os nomes dos doze apóstolos do Cordeiro.
text_el: καὶ τὸ τεῖχος τῆς πόλεως ἔχων θεμελίους δώδεκα, καὶ ἐπ' αὐτῶν δώδεκα ὀνόματα τῶν δώδεκα ἀποστόλων τοῦ ἀρνίου.

text_en: and he that spoke with me had a measure of a reed of gold, to measure the city and the gates thereof and the wall.
text_la: Et qui loquebatur mecum, habebat mensuram arundineam auream, ut metiretur civitatem, et portas ejus, et murum.
text_pt: E aquele que falava comigo tinha uma cana de ouro, para medir a cidade, e as suas portas, e o seu muro.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λαλῶν μετ' ἐμοῦ εἶχεν μέτρον κάλαμον χρυσοῦν, ἵνα μετρήσῃ τὴν πόλιν καὶ τοὺς πυλῶνας αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ τεῖχος αὐτῆς.

text_en: And the city lies in a four-square: and the length thereof is as great as the breadth. And he measured the city with the golden reed for twelve thousand furlongs: and the length and the height and the breadth thereof are equal.
text_la: Et civitas in quadro posita est, et longitudo ejus tanta est quanta et latitudo : et mensus est civitatem de arundine aurea per stadia duodecim millia : et longitudo, et altitudo, et latitudo ejus æqualia sunt.
text_pt: E a cidade estava situada em quadrado; e o seu comprimento era tanto como a sua largura. E mediu a cidade com a cana até doze mil estádios; e o seu comprimento, largura e altura eram iguais.
text_el: καὶ ἡ πόλις τετράγωνος κεῖται, καὶ τὸ μῆκος αὐτῆς ὅσον τὸ πλάτος. καὶ ἐμέτρησεν τὴν πόλιν τῷ καλάμῳ ἐπὶ σταδίων δώδεκα χιλιάδων: τὸ μῆκος καὶ τὸ πλάτος καὶ τὸ ὕψος αὐτῆς ἴσα ἐστίν.

text_en: And he measured the wall thereof an hundred forty-four cubits, the measure of a man , which is of an angel .
text_la: Et mensus est murum ejus centum quadraginta quatuor cubitorum, mensura hominis, quæ est angeli.
text_pt: E mediu o seu muro, de cento e quarenta e quatro côvados, conforme à medida de homem, que é a de um anjo.
text_el: καὶ ἐμέτρησεν τὸ τεῖχος αὐτῆς ἑκατὸν τεσσεράκοντα τεσσάρων πηχῶν, μέτρον ἀνθρώπου, ὅ ἐστιν ἀγγέλου.

text_en: And the building of the wall thereof was of jasper stone: but the city itself pure gold like to clear glass.
text_la: Et erat structura muri ejus ex lapide jaspide : ipsa vero civitas aurum mundum simile vitro mundo.
text_pt: E a construção do seu muro era de jaspe, e a cidade de ouro puro, semelhante a vidro puro.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ἐνδώμησις τοῦ τείχους αὐτῆς ἴασπις, καὶ ἡ πόλις χρυσίον καθαρὸν ὅμοιον ὑάλῳ καθαρῷ.

text_en: And the foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with all manner of precious stones . The first foundation was jasper: the second, sapphire: the third; a chalcedony: the fourth, an emerald:
text_la: Et fundamenta muri civitatis omni lapide pretioso ornata. Fundamentum primum, jaspis : secundum, sapphirus : tertium, calcedonius : quartum, smaragdus:
text_pt: E os fundamentos do muro da cidade estavam adornados de toda a pedra preciosa. O primeiro fundamento era jaspe; o segundo, safira; o terceiro, calcedônia; o quarto, esmeralda;
text_el: οἱ θεμέλιοι τοῦ τείχους τῆς πόλεως παντὶ λίθῳ τιμίῳ κεκοσμημένοι: ὁ θεμέλιος ὁ πρῶτος ἴασπις, ὁ δεύτερος σάπφιρος, ὁ τρίτος χαλκηδών, ὁ τέταρτος σμάραγδος,

text_en: The fifth, sardonyx: the sixth, sardius: the seventh, chrysolite: the eighth, beryl: the ninth, a topaz: the tenth, a chrysoprasus: the eleventh, a jacinth: the twelfth, an amethyst.
text_la: quintum, sardonyx : sextum, sardius : septimum, chrysolithus : octavum, beryllus : nonum, topazius : decimum, chrysoprasus : undecimum, hyacinthus : duodecimum, amethystus.
text_pt: O quinto, sardônica; o sexto, sárdio; o sétimo, crisólito; o oitavo, berilo; o nono, topázio; o décimo, crisópraso; o undécimo, jacinto; o duodécimo, ametista.
text_el: ὁ πέμπτος σαρδόνυξ, ὁ ἕκτος σάρδιον, ὁ ἕβδομος χρυσόλιθος, ὁ ὄγδοος βήρυλλος, ὁ ἔνατος τοπάζιον, ὁ δέκατος χρυσόπρασος, ὁ ἑνδέκατος ὑάκινθος, ὁ δωδέκατος ἀμέθυστος.

text_en: And the twelve gates are twelve pearls, one to each: and every several gate was of one several pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, as it were, transparent glass.
text_la: Et duodecim portæ, duodecim margaritæ sunt, per singulas : et singulæ portæ erant ex singulis margaritis : et platea civitatis aurum mundum, tamquam vitrum perlucidum.
text_pt: E as doze portas eram doze pérolas; cada uma das portas era uma pérola; e a praça da cidade de ouro puro, como vidro transparente.
text_el: καὶ οἱ δώδεκα πυλῶνες δώδεκα μαργαρῖται, ἀνὰ εἷς ἕκαστος τῶν πυλώνων ἦν ἐξ ἑνὸς μαργαρίτου. καὶ ἡ πλατεῖα τῆς πόλεως χρυσίον καθαρὸν ὡς ὕαλος διαυγής.

text_en: And I saw no temple therein. For the Lord God Almighty is the temple thereof, and the Lamb .
text_la: Et templum non vidi in ea : Dominus enim Deus omnipotens templum illius est, et Agnus.
text_pt: E nela não vi templo, porque o seu templo é o Senhor Deus Todo-Poderoso, e o Cordeiro.
text_el: καὶ ναὸν οὐκ εἶδον ἐν αὐτῇ, ὁ γὰρ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ναὸς αὐτῆς ἐστιν, καὶ τὸ ἀρνίον.

text_en: And the city has no need of the sun, nor of the moon, to shine in it. For the glory of God has enlightened it: and the Lamb is the lamp thereof.
text_la: Et civitas non eget sole neque luna ut luceant in ea, nam claritas Dei illuminavit eam, et lucerna ejus est Agnus.
text_pt: E a cidade não necessita de sol nem de lua, para que nela resplandeçam, porque a glória de Deus a tem iluminado, e o Cordeiro é a sua lâmpada.
text_el: καὶ ἡ πόλις οὐ χρείαν ἔχει τοῦ ἡλίου οὐδὲ τῆς σελήνης, ἵνα φαίνωσιν αὐτῇ, ἡ γὰρ δόξα τοῦ θεοῦ ἐφώτισεν αὐτήν, καὶ ὁ λύχνος αὐτῆς τὸ ἀρνίον.

text_en: And the nations shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth shall bring their glory and honour into it.
text_la: Et ambulabunt gentes in lumine ejus : et reges terræ afferent gloriam suam et honorem in illam.
text_pt: E as nações dos salvos andarão à sua luz; e os reis da terra trarão para ela a sua glória e honra.
text_el: καὶ περιπατήσουσιν τὰ ἔθνη διὰ τοῦ φωτὸς αὐτῆς: καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς φέρουσιν τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν εἰς αὐτήν:

text_en: And the gates thereof shall not be shut by day: for there shall be no night there.
text_la: Et portæ ejus non claudentur per diem : nox enim non erit illic.
text_pt: E as suas portas não se fecharão de dia, porque ali não haverá noite.
text_el: καὶ οἱ πυλῶνες αὐτῆς οὐ μὴ κλεισθῶσιν ἡμέρας, νὺξ γὰρ οὐκ ἔσται ἐκεῖ:

text_en: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
text_la: Et afferent gloriam et honorem gentium in illam.
text_pt: E a ela trarão a glória e honra das nações.
text_el: καὶ οἴσουσιν τὴν δόξαν καὶ τὴν τιμὴν τῶν ἐθνῶν εἰς αὐτήν.

text_en: There shall not enter into it anything defiled or that works abomination or makes a lie: but they that are written in the book of life of the Lamb .
text_la: Non intrabit in eam aliquod coinquinatum, aut abominationem faciens et mendacium, nisi qui scripti sunt in libro vitæ Agni.
text_pt: E não entrará nela coisa alguma que contamine, e cometa abominação e mentira; mas só os que estão inscritos no livro da vida do Cordeiro.
text_el: καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτὴν πᾶν κοινὸν καὶ ὁ ποιῶν βδέλυγμα καὶ ψεῦδος, εἰ μὴ οἱ γεγραμμένοι ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ ἀρνίου.

text_en: And he showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding from the throne of God and of the Lamb .
text_la: Et ostendit mihi fluvium aquæ vitæ, splendidum tamquam crystallum, procedentem de sede Dei et Agni.
text_pt: E mostrou-me o rio puro da água da vida, claro como cristal, que procedia do trono de Deus e do Cordeiro.
text_el: Καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι ποταμὸν ὕδατος ζωῆς λαμπρὸν ὡς κρύσταλλον, ἐκπορευόμενον ἐκ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἀρνίου.

text_en: In the midst of the street thereof, and on both sides of the river, was the tree of life, bearing twelve fruits, yielding its fruits every month: the leaves of the tree for the healing of the nations.
text_la: In medio plateæ ejus, et ex utraque parte fluminis, lignum vitæ, afferens fructus duodecim per menses singulos, reddens fructum suum et folia ligni ad sanitatem gentium.
text_pt: No meio da sua praça, e de um e de outro lado do rio, estava a árvore da vida, que produz doze frutos, dando seu fruto de mês em mês; e as folhas da árvore são para a saúde das nações.
text_el: ἐν μέσῳ τῆς πλατείας αὐτῆς καὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἐντεῦθεν καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ξύλον ζωῆς ποιοῦν καρποὺς δώδεκα, κατὰ μῆνα ἕκαστον ἀποδιδοῦν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὰ φύλλα τοῦ ξύλου εἰς θεραπείαν τῶν ἐθνῶν.

text_en: And there shall be no curse any more: but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it. And his servants shall serve him.
text_la: Et omne maledictum non erit amplius : sed sedes Dei et Agni in illa erunt, et servi ejus servient illi.
text_pt: E ali nunca mais haverá maldição contra alguém; e nela estará o trono de Deus e do Cordeiro, e os seus servos o servirão.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν κατάθεμα οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι. καὶ ὁ θρόνος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ τοῦ ἀρνίου ἐν αὐτῇ ἔσται, καὶ οἱ δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ λατρεύσουσιν αὐτῷ,

text_en: And they shall see his face: and his name shall be on their foreheads.
text_la: Et videbunt faciem ejus : et nomen ejus in frontibus eorum.
text_pt: E verão o seu rosto, e nas suas testas estará o seu nome.
text_el: καὶ ὄψονται τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ, καὶ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν.

text_en: And night shall be no more. And they shall not need the light of the lamp, nor the light of the sun, because the Lord God shall enlighten them. And they shall reign for ever and ever.
text_la: Et nox ultra non erit : et non egebunt lumine lucernæ, neque lumine solis, quoniam Dominus Deus illuminabit illos, et regnabunt in sæcula sæculorum.
text_pt: E ali não haverá mais noite, e não necessitarão de lâmpada nem de luz do sol, porque o Senhor Deus os ilumina; e reinarão para todo o sempre.
text_el: καὶ νὺξ οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι, καὶ οὐκ ἔχουσιν χρείαν φωτὸς λύχνου καὶ φῶς ἡλίου, ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεὸς φωτίσει [ἐπ]' αὐτούς, καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.

text_en: And he said to me: These words are most faithful and true . And the Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show his servant the things which must be done shortly.
text_la: Et dixit mihi : Hæc verba fidelissima sunt, et vera. Et Dominus Deus spirituum prophetarum misit angelum suum ostendere servis suis quæ oportet fieri cito.
text_pt: E disse-me: Estas palavras são fiéis e verdadeiras; e o Senhor, o Deus dos santos profetas, enviou o seu anjo, para mostrar aos seus servos as coisas que em breve hão de acontecer.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι, οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι πιστοὶ καὶ ἀληθινοί, καὶ ὁ κύριος, ὁ θεὸς τῶν πνευμάτων τῶν προφητῶν, ἀπέστειλεν τὸν ἄγγελον αὐτοῦ δεῖξαι τοῖς δούλοις αὐτοῦ ἃ δεῖ γενέσθαι ἐν τάχει.

text_en: And: Behold I come quickly. Blessed is he that keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.
text_la: Et ecce venio velociter. Beatus, qui custodit verba prophetiæ libri hujus.
text_pt: Eis que presto venho: Bem-aventurado aquele que guarda as palavras da profecia deste livro.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ. μακάριος ὁ τηρῶν τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου.

text_en: And I, John , who have heard and seen these things. And, after I had heard and seen, I fell down to adore before the feet of the angel who showed me these things.
text_la: Et ego Joannes, qui audivi, et vidi hæc. Et postquam audissem, et vidissem, cecidi ut adorarem ante pedes angeli, qui mihi hæc ostendebat:
text_pt: E eu, João, sou aquele que vi e ouvi estas coisas. E, havendo-as ouvido e visto, prostrei-me aos pés do anjo que mas mostrava para o adorar.
text_el: Κἀγὼ Ἰωάννης ὁ ἀκούων καὶ βλέπων ταῦτα. καὶ ὅτε ἤκουσα καὶ ἔβλεψα, ἔπεσα προσκυνῆσαι ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ποδῶν τοῦ ἀγγέλου τοῦ δεικνύοντός μοι ταῦτα.

text_en: And he said to me: See thou do it not. For I am your fellow servant, and of your brethren the prophets and of them that keep the words of the prophecy of this book. Adore God .
text_la: et dixit mihi : Vide ne feceris : conservus enim tuus sum, et fratrum tuorum prophetarum, et eorum qui servant verba prophetiæ libri hujus : Deum adora.
text_pt: E disse-me: Olha, não faças tal; porque eu sou conservo teu e de teus irmãos, os profetas, e dos que guardam as palavras deste livro. Adora a Deus.
text_el: καὶ λέγει μοι, ὅρα μή: σύνδουλός σού εἰμι καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῶν τηρούντων τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου: τῷ θεῷ προσκύνησον.

text_en: And he says to me: Seal not the words of the prophecy of this book. For the time is at hand.
text_la: Et dicit mihi : Ne signaveris verba prophetiæ libri hujus : tempus enim prope est.
text_pt: E disse-me: Não seles as palavras da profecia deste livro; porque próximo está o tempo.
text_el: καὶ λέγει μοι, μὴ σφραγίσῃς τοὺς λόγους τῆς προφητείας τοῦ βιβλίου τούτου, ὁ καιρὸς γὰρ ἐγγύς ἐστιν.

text_en: He that hurts, let him hurt still: and he that is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is just , let him be justified still: and he that is holy , let him be sanctified still.
text_la: Qui nocet, noceat adhuc : et qui in sordibus est, sordescat adhuc : et qui justus est, justificetur adhuc : et sanctus, sanctificetur adhuc.
text_pt: Quem é injusto, seja injusto ainda; e quem é sujo, seja sujo ainda; e quem é justo, seja justificado ainda; e quem é santo, seja santificado ainda.
text_el: ὁ ἀδικῶν ἀδικησάτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ ῥυπαρὸς ῥυπανθήτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ δίκαιος δικαιοσύνην ποιησάτω ἔτι, καὶ ὁ ἅγιος ἁγιασθήτω ἔτι.

text_en: Behold, I come quickly: and my reward is with me, to render to every man according to his works.
text_la: Ecce venio cito, et merces mea mecum est, reddere unicuique secundum opera sua.
text_pt: E, eis que cedo venho, e o meu galardão está comigo, para dar a cada um segundo a sua obra.
text_el: Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ταχύ, καὶ ὁ μισθός μου μετ' ἐμοῦ, ἀποδοῦναι ἑκάστῳ ὡς τὸ ἔργον ἐστὶν αὐτοῦ.

text_en: I am Alpha and Omega , the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
text_la: Ego sum alpha et omega, primus et novissimus, principium et finis.
text_pt: Eu sou o Alfa e o Ômega, o princípio e o fim, o primeiro e o derradeiro.
text_el: ἐγὼ τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ τέλος.

text_en: Blessed are they that wash their robes in the blood of the Lamb : that they may have a right to the tree of life and may enter in by the gates into the city.
text_la: Beati, qui lavant stolas suas in sanguine Agni : ut sit potestas eorum in ligno vitæ, et per portas intrent in civitatem.
